name: Flutiflo Nasal Spray 10ml
introduction:
Introduction About FLUTIFLO NASAL SPRAY

FLUTIFLO NASAL SPRAY contains Fluticasone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids (glucocorticoids). It is used to manage symptoms of allergic rhinitis such as stuffy, runny, or itchy nose, sneezing, itchy, red, or watery eyes in adults and children above 6 years of age.

Allergic rhinitis may be defined as an inflammatory disease of the nasal mucosa caused due to allergies caused form certain things such as pollen from grass or trees, animals (cats and dogs), house-dust mites, or moulds.

Before using FLUTIFLO NASAL SPRAY tell your doctor if you have severe liver disease, any history of eye conditions such as glaucoma (increase in pressure in the eye) or cataracts (clouding of the lens of the eye), or had nose surgery, or got an infection in your nose.

FLUTIFLO NASAL SPRAY should not be used in pregnant and breastfeeding women, unless advised clearly necessary by the doctor. Contact your doctor before using. FLUTIFLO NASAL SPRAY is not recommended for use in children below 6 years of age. FLUTIFLO NASAL SPRAY should be used with caution in elderly patients. Therefore, contact your doctor before using.

The most common side effects of using FLUTIFLO NASAL SPRAY include nosebleeds (generally minor), nasal ulceration, headache, and shortness of breath. Contact your doctor if any of these worsen or doesn’t improve.
uses: Manages symptoms of allergic rhinitis such as stuffy, runny, or itchy nose, sneezing, itchy, red, or watery eyes in adults and children above 6 years of age
usesDetails:
Uses Of FLUTIFLO NASAL SPRAY
Manages symptoms of allergic rhinitis such as stuffy, runny, or itchy nose, sneezing, itchy, red, or watery eyes in adults and children above 6 years of age
mechanismOfAction:
How FLUTIFLO NASAL SPRAY Works

FLUTIFLO NASAL SPRAY causes vasoconstriction (constriction of blood vessels) and has anti-inflammatory activity. It directly decreases the cells that cause inflammation such as eosinophils, monocytes, mast cells, macrophages, and dendritic cells. FLUTIFLO NASAL SPRAY also decreases mucus gland secretions. Therefore, helps in reducing inflammation and making it easier to breathe.
usageDetails:
How to use FLUTIFLO NASAL SPRAY

Use FLUTIFLO NASAL SPRAY as advised by your physician. It is for intranasal use only. Shake the bottle before every use. Your doctor will decide what quantity of dose you require at what frequency depending on the severity of the disease and your physical characteristics. Do not start or stop the medicine without consulting your doctor.
sideEffects: Nasal ulceration (irritation or discomfort in the nose, streaks of blood while blowing the nose)
Pain, burning, irritation, soreness, or dryness inside the nose

Allergic reactions (symptoms include wheezing, coughing, or difficulty breathing, sudden weakness or light-headedness (leading to collapse or loss of consciousness), swelling around the face, skin rashes or redness
Blurred vision or other visual disturbances

Side Effects Of FLUTIFLO NASAL SPRAY
Common
Nosebleeds (generally minor)
Nasal ulceration (irritation or discomfort in the nose, streaks of blood while blowing the nose)
Headache
Shortness of breath
Uncommon

Rare

Allergic reactions (symptoms include wheezing, coughing, or difficulty breathing, sudden weakness or light-headedness (leading to collapse or loss of consciousness), swelling around the face, skin rashes or redness
Blurred vision or other visual disturbances

warnings.details: FLUTIFLO NASAL SPRAY should not be used in pregnant women, unless advised clearly necessary by the doctor. Contact your doctor before using.
FLUTIFLO NASAL SPRAY should not be used in breastfeeding women, unless advised clearly necessary by the doctor. Contact your doctor before using
FLUTIFLO NASAL SPRAY is unlikely to affect your ability to drive and use machines.
FLUTIFLO NASAL SPRAY should be used with caution in patients having severe hepatic impairment. Consult with your doctor before using.
Do not use FLUTIFLO NASAL SPRAY if you are allergic to Fluticasone or any of the other ingredients of this medicine.

Others

Before using FLUTIFLO NASAL SPRAY tell your doctor if you have:

History of eye conditions such as glaucoma (increase in pressure in the eye) or cataracts (clouding of the lens of the eye)
Had a nose surgery
An infection in your nose

Use in Paediatrics:

FLUTIFLO NASAL SPRAY is not recommended for use in children below 6 years of age. Occurrence of growth retardation is possible with prolonged use of FLUTIFLO NASAL SPRAY. Your doctor will keep a check on the child’s height and modify the doses as required. Therefore, contact your child’s doctor before using FLUTIFLO NASAL SPRAY for your child.

Use in Geriatrics:

FLUTIFLO NASAL SPRAY should be used with caution in elderly patients. Therefore, contact your doctor before using.

A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

name: Momeflo Nasal Spray 10ml
introduction:
Introduction About MOMEFLO NASAL SPRAY

MOMEFLO NASAL SPRAY contains Mometasone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids. MOMEFLO NASAL SPRAY is used to manage the symptoms of hay fever (seasonal allergic rhinitis) and perennial rhinitis in adults and children aged 2 and older. This medicine is also used to manage nasal polyps in adults aged 18 and over.

Hay Fever is an allergic reaction which occurs due to breathing in pollen from trees, grasses, weeds, molds and fungal spores generally characterized by blocked or runny nose, sneezing and coughing.

Perennial rhinitis is an inflammatory condition which occurs due to sensitivity to a variety of things such as house dust mite, animal hair, feathers and certain foods characterized by symptoms such as blocked nose, sneezing, itching that might occur for an hour or more on most days throughout the year.

Nasal polyps are small growths on the lining of the nose which usually affects both nostrils generally characterized by runny nose, and stuffiness.

Avoid using MOMEFLO NASAL SPRAY, if you are allergic to Mometasone, and or have an unmanageed infection in your nose such as herpes, recent injury or operation on your nose.

Before using MOMEFLO NASAL SPRAY, inform your doctor if you have kidney, or liver disease. MOMEFLO NASAL SPRAY should be used in pregnant women only if it is clearly necessary. It should be used with caution in breastfeeding women.

Your doctor will give the right dose depends on your child’s age, body weight and disease condition. Consult your doctor before using MOMEFLO NASAL SPRAY.

The most common side effects of using MOMEFLO NASAL SPRAY are headache, sneezing, nose bleeds, sore nose or throat, ulcers in the nose and or respiratory tract infection. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms gets worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How MOMEFLO NASAL SPRAY Works

MOMEFLO NASAL SPRAY works by reducing the swelling and irritation in the nose thereby providing relief from sneezing, itching, or a blocked-up or runny nose due to hay fever or perennial rhinitis. In nasal polyps, it relieves the blocked feeling in the nose by reducing the inflammation in the nose thereby enabling easy breathing through the nose.

Always use MOMEFLO NASAL SPRAY as directed by your physician. It is for intranasal use only. Shake well before each use. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Check the label for directions for use.

It is not known if MOMEFLO NASAL SPRAY is found in breast milk, hence consult your doctor before using MOMEFLO NASAL SPRAY.
MOMEFLO NASAL SPRAY has no known influence on the ability to drive or operate machines. Consult your doctor before using MOMEFLO NASAL SPRAY.
Do not use MOMEFLO NASAL SPRAY if you are allergic to Mometasone or to any other ingredients of this medicine.

Others

MOMEFLO NASAL SPRAY is not recommended for use if you have:

Have an unmanageed infection in your nose such as herpes
Had a recent operation on your nose
Had a recent injury to your nose

Before using MOMEFLO NASAL SPRAY, inform your doctor if you:

Have or had tuberculosis
Have any other type of infection
Have cystic fibrosis  

Use in pediatrics:

Your doctor will give the right dose depends on your child’s age, body weight and disease condition. Consult your doctor before using MOMEFLO NASAL SPRAY.

Use in geriatrics:

MOMEFLO NASAL SPRAY should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 60 years or above). Consult your doctor before using MOMEFLO NASAL SPRAY.

name: NASIVION CHILD Nasal Drops 10ml
introduction:
Introduction About NASIVION CHILD NASAL DROPS

Nasivion Paediatric Nasal Drops is a nasal decongestant used in children (1-6 years old) to relieve blocked nose that occurs due to common cold, dust and pollution, or seasonal changes. It contains oxymetazoline as an active ingredient that helps to reduce swelling and congestion.

Oxymetazoline works by narrowing the blood vessels in the nasal area, thus reducing swelling and congestion, and making it easier for your child to breathe. It is also found to exert some antiviral effects.

Use Nasivion Paediatric Nasal Drops exactly as advised by your child’s doctor. It is for intranasal use only. Do not use Nasivion Paediatric Nasal Drops for more than 10 days without your doctor’s advice.
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of NASIVION CHILD NASAL DROPS

Consult doctor if your child is experiencing any unusual side effects while using Nasivion Paediatric Nasal Drops.

introduction:
Introduction About NASIVION ADULT CLASSIC NASAL SPRAY

Nasivion Classic Adult Nasal Spray is a nasal decongestant used in adults to decongest a blocked nose quickly for fast relief and provides up to 12 hours of easier breathing. It contains oxymetazoline as an active ingredient that helps to reduce swelling and congestion.

Oxymetazoline works by narrowing the blood vessels in the nasal area, thus reducing swelling and congestion, and making it easier for you to breathe.

Use Nasivion Classic Adult Nasal Spray exactly as advised by your doctor. It is for intranasal use only. It is not recommended for use in babies and children (under 6 years of age). Ask your doctor before using it during pregnancy and breastfeeding.
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of NASIVION ADULT CLASSIC NASAL SPRAY

Nasivion Classic Adult Nasal Spray might cause mild burning or stinging of the nose, sneezing, or runny nose in some individuals. Consult your doctor if you experience any such effects while using it.

name: Xylomist P Nasal Drops 10ml
introduction:
Introduction About XYLOMIST P NASAL DROPS

XYLOMIST P NASAL DROPS contains Xylometazoline which belongs to the group of medicines called Nasal decongestants. It is used in children (aged between 1-11 years) to provide relief from nasal congestion caused due to common cold, sinusitis (inflammation of the sinuses) or allergic rhinitis (an allergic condition).

Always use XYLOMIST P NASAL DROPS as directed by your physician. It is for intranasal use only. Do not use XYLOMIST P NASAL DROPS for more than 10 days to your child without consulting your doctor.

Before using XYLOMIST P NASAL DROPS inform your doctor if your child has heart problems or thyroid problems. You must also inform your doctor if your child has any other problems in the nasal tract apart from nasal congestion such as nasal inflammation, nasal dryness or any recent surgery in the nose.

XYLOMIST P NASAL DROPS should not be used in adults unless recommended by a doctor. The most common side effects of using XYLOMIST P NASAL DROPS are irritation or burning sensation after application and nasal dryness. Consult your doctor if they bother your child.
uses: Nasal congestion (blocked nose)
usesDetails:
Uses Of XYLOMIST P NASAL DROPS

It is used in children (aged between 1-11 years) to provide relief from:

Nasal congestion (blocked nose)
mechanismOfAction:
How XYLOMIST P NASAL DROPS Works

XYLOMIST P NASAL DROPS opens and clears the nasal passages. It works by narrowing down the blood vessels supplying the nasal passage. This helps swollen blood vessels of the nasal tract to return to its normal size which allows the air to pass through the nostrils more freely. It also reduces excessive nasal secretions and provides temporary relief from nasal inflammation, swelling and discomfort.
usageDetails:
How to use XYLOMIST P NASAL DROPS

Always use XYLOMIST P NASAL DROPS as directed by your physician. It is for intranasal use only.

For Nasal Drops: Gently instill few drops of this medicine into each nostril. Clean the dropper after application.

For Nasal Spray: Insert the spray nozzle inside the affected nostril. Press the pump to release the spray and sniff at the same time. Repeat the same to the other nostril if required. Clean the nozzle after application.

To avoid possible spread of infection, this pack should only be used by a single person. Do not use XYLOMIST P NASAL DROPS for more than 10 days without consulting your doctor. Discard the unused portion after 28 days of opening it.

Severe allergic reactions (such as swelling of the face, lips, tongue, and/or throat which can lead to difficulty in breathing or swallowing)
Restlessness, hallucination and problems in sleeping

XYLOMIST P NASAL DROPS is intended for use only in the children. Therefore, it should not be used in adults unless recommended by a doctor.
XYLOMIST P NASAL DROPS does not affect your child’s ability to drive or operate any heavy tools.
Do not use XYLOMIST P NASAL DROPS if your child is allergic to Xylometazoline or to any other ingredients of this medicine.
XYLOMIST P NASAL DROPS should be used with caution in children with heart disease (such as hypertension, prolonged QT syndrome). Therefore, consult your doctor before administration.

Others

XYLOMIST P NASAL DROPS is not recommended for use if your child:

Has any inflammation in the nasal passages
Recently had a neurosurgery or surgery in their nose
Has closed angle glaucoma (increased pressure within the eyes)
Has chronic nasal inflammation and nasal dryness (such as rhinitis sicca or atrophic rhinitis)
Has phaeochromocytoma (a rare tumor of the adrenal glands)

Before using XYLOMIST P NASAL DROPS inform your doctor if your child has:

Diabetes
Hyperthyroidism (overactive thyroid gland)
An enlarged prostate gland

Use in pediatrics:

XYLOMIST P NASAL DROPS can be used in children and adolescents aged between 1-11 years. It is not recommended for use in infants aged below 1 year. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice before administration.

Use in geriatrics:

XYLOMIST P NASAL DROPS is intended for use only in the children. Therefore, it should not be used in adults unless recommended by a doctor.

Antidepressants (used to manage depression) such as monoamine oxidase inhibitors (Ex. moclobemide, isocarboxazid, phenelzine and tranylcypromine), tricyclic antidepressants (Ex. amitriptyline, nortriptyline), lithium, fluoxetine, sertraline, citalopram, escitalopram etc
Medicines used to control blood pressure such as alpha blockers (Ex. prazosin, terazocin) or beta blockers (Ex. propranolol, atenolol)
Timolol, betaxolol (used to manage glaucoma in the eye)

introduction:
Introduction About SOLVIN VAPOCAP

SOLVIN VAPOCAP is a combination of Camphor, Chlorothymol, Eucalyptus Oil, Menthol, and Terpineol which belongs to the group of medicines called Antitussives, Antimicrobials, Expectorants, Nasal Decongestants, and Antibacterial agents respectively. It is used to relieve the blockage in the nasal passage and helps in better breathing.

SOLVIN VAPOCAP is used to relieve nasal symptoms such as runny nose, itchy nose, stuffy nose, sneezing, and post-nasal drip. also manages cough, common cold, minor pain, and certain bacterial infections.

SOLVIN VAPOCAP is also used to reduce skin itching after eczema. Eczema is a condition that occurs due to certain irritants or infectious agents and is characterized by inflammation, itching, cracking, and roughing of the skin.

Before taking this medicine, inform your doctor if you have hepatocellular carcinoma (liver cancer), end-stage kidney disease, or if you are on haemodialysis. SOLVIN VAPOCAP is not recommended for use by pregnant, breastfeeding women and in children (aged below 3 years). SOLVIN VAPOCAP should be used cautiously in children (below 6 years).

The most common side effects associated with the use of SOLVIN VAPOCAP are nasal irritation, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, headache, dizziness, and confusion. Consult your doctor if any of your symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How SOLVIN VAPOCAP Works

SOLVIN VAPOCAP contains camphor that inhibits cough by acting on certain receptors in the brainstem that controls the cough reflex. It also reduces inflammation by activating certain heat-sensitive receptors, providing relief from pain and inflammation.

Chlorothymol works by inhibiting the growth and multiplication of infection-causing agents such as bacteria and viruses. Eucalyptus Oil works by suppressing the release of inflammation-causing agents. It also inhibits the secretion of mucous, reducing its viscosity, and accelerating the movement of mucus for its clearance.

Menthol works by minimizing nasal congestion. It also provides a cooling effect, minimizing irritation. Terpineol works by killing or stopping the multiplication of bacteria causing infection.
usageDetails:
How to use SOLVIN VAPOCAP

Take SOLVIN VAPOCAP as advised by your physician. It is for inhalational use only. Cut and open this medicine and pour the contents in hot water or on paper to take steam or smell. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Xylomist 0.1% Nasal Drops 10ml
introduction:
Introduction About XYLOMIST 0.1% NASAL DROPS

XYLOMIST 0.1% NASAL DROPS is used for symptomatic relief from nasal congestion caused due to allergies and common cold. It contains a medicine called xylometazoline which works by thinning the mucus present in the nasal tract. 

Always use XYLOMIST 0.1% NASAL DROPS as directed by your physician. Gently instil 1-2 drops in each nostril, one or two times daily or as directed by the physician. It is for intranasal use only. Do not use XYLOMIST 0.1% NASAL DROPS for more than 7 days without consulting your doctor.

Before using XYLOMIST 0.1% NASAL DROPS inform your doctor if you have diabetes, hypertension, glaucoma, hyperthyroidism, or any heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any other problems in nasal tract apart from nasal congestion such as chronic nasal inflammation with very dry nasal passages (rhinitis sicca or atrophic rhinitis).

The most common side effects of using XYLOMIST 0.1% NASAL DROPS are irritation or burning sensation after application and nasal dryness. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Nasal congestion
usesDetails:
Uses Of XYLOMIST 0.1% NASAL DROPS
Nasal congestion
mechanismOfAction:
How XYLOMIST 0.1% NASAL DROPS Works

XYLOMIST 0.1% NASAL DROPS opens and clears the nasal passages. It works by narrowing down the blood vessels supplying the nasal passage. This helps swollen blood vessels of the nasal tract to return to its normal size which allows the air to pass through the nostrils more freely. It also reduces excessive nasal secretions and provides temporary relief from nasal inflammation, swelling and discomfort.
usageDetails:
How to use XYLOMIST 0.1% NASAL DROPS

Always use XYLOMIST 0.1% NASAL DROPS as directed by your physician. It is for intranasal use only.

For Nasal Drops: Gently instil few drops of this medicine into each nostril.  One to two drops in each nostril, one or two times daily or as directed by the physician. Clean the dropper after application.

For Nasal Spray: Insert the spray nozzle inside the affected nostril. Press the pump to release the spray and sniff at the same time. Repeat the same to the other nostril if required. Clean the nozzle after application.

To avoid possible spread of infection, this pack should only be used by a single person. Do not use XYLOMIST 0.1% NASAL DROPS for more than 7 days without consulting your doctor. Discard the unused portion after 28 days of opening it.

introduction:
Introduction About ALLEGRA NASAL SPRAY

ALLEGRA NASAL SPRAY contains Fluticasone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids (glucocorticoids). It is used to manage symptoms of allergic rhinitis such as stuffy, runny, or itchy nose, sneezing, itchy, red, or watery eyes in adults and children above 6 years of age.

Allergic rhinitis may be defined as an inflammatory disease of the nasal mucosa caused due to allergies caused form certain things such as pollen from grass or trees, animals (cats and dogs), house-dust mites, or moulds.

Before using ALLEGRA NASAL SPRAY tell your doctor if you have severe liver disease, any history of eye conditions such as glaucoma (increase in pressure in the eye) or cataracts (clouding of the lens of the eye), or had nose surgery, or got an infection in your nose.

ALLEGRA NASAL SPRAY should not be used in pregnant and breastfeeding women, unless advised clearly necessary by the doctor. Contact your doctor before using. ALLEGRA NASAL SPRAY is not recommended for use in children below 6 years of age. ALLEGRA NASAL SPRAY should be used with caution in elderly patients. Therefore, contact your doctor before using.

The most common side effects of using ALLEGRA NASAL SPRAY include nosebleeds (generally minor), nasal ulceration, headache, and shortness of breath. Contact your doctor if any of these worsen or doesn’t improve.

usesDetails:
Uses Of ALLEGRA NASAL SPRAY
Manages symptoms of allergic rhinitis such as stuffy, runny, or itchy nose, sneezing, itchy, red, or watery eyes in adults and children above 6 years of age
mechanismOfAction:
How ALLEGRA NASAL SPRAY Works

ALLEGRA NASAL SPRAY causes vasoconstriction (constriction of blood vessels) and has anti-inflammatory activity. It directly decreases the cells that cause inflammation such as eosinophils, monocytes, mast cells, macrophages, and dendritic cells. ALLEGRA NASAL SPRAY also decreases mucus gland secretions. Therefore, helps in reducing inflammation and making it easier to breathe.
usageDetails:
How to use ALLEGRA NASAL SPRAY

Use ALLEGRA NASAL SPRAY as advised by your physician. It is for intranasal use only. Shake the bottle before every use. Your doctor will decide what quantity of dose you require at what frequency depending on the severity of the disease and your physical characteristics. Do not start or stop the medicine without consulting your doctor.

name: Nazodrop Nasal Drops 10ml
introduction:
Introduction About NAZODROP

Nazodrop Nasal drops is a nasal decongestant drop used to restore moisture and relieve dry, crushed, and inflamed nasal membranes due to cold, low humidity, nasal decongestant overuse, allergies and following nasal or sinus surgeries. It contains sodium chloride as an active ingredient that helps to moisturize the nasal cavity.

Sodium chloride moisturizes the nasal passage and helps to dissolve and soften thick or crusty mucus that relieves nasal congestion.

Always use Nazodrop Nasal drops exactly as advised by your doctor. It is for external use only. It is advised to instil two-three drops into each nostril three-four times daily or as directed by your physician. Do not exceed the daily recommended dosage.
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of NAZODROP

Nazodrop Nasal drops may cause dryness, stinging, and irritation in nose in some individuals. Consult a doctor if any of these symptoms worsen with time for you while using these drops.

introduction:
Introduction About FEBREX PLUS TABLET

FEBREX PLUS TABLET is a combination of Chlorpheniramine, Paracetamol and Phenylephrine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihistamines, Analgesics and Nasal decongestants respectively. It is used to relieve the symptoms of hay fever, common cold or other upper respiratory allergies, like headache, facial congestion and pressure, nasal congestion, runny nose, sneezing, minor aches and pains, itching of the nose, throat or eyes and watery eyes. It can also be used to clear nasal passages and decongest facial openings and passages.

Hay fever is a seasonal allergy that occurs in response to specific allergens like pollens, present at certain times of the year (spring or fall) and causes more short-term symptoms.

FEBREX PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged less than 12 years). Consult your doctor before giving this medicine to your child.

Before taking FEBREX PLUS TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any kidney, liver, heart, thyroid or lung problems, diabetes or glaucoma.

FEBREX PLUS TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women, so consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects of taking FEBREX PLUS TABLET are dizziness, drowsiness, dry mouth, nose or throat, headache, nausea, nervousness and difficulty in sleeping. Contact your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How FEBREX PLUS TABLET Works

FEBREX PLUS TABLET relieves upper respiratory symptoms where Chlorpheniramine binds to the histamine H1 receptor and blocks its action, resulting in temporary relief of the negative symptoms (runny nose, sneezing, watery and itchy eyes) brought on by histamine, where Paracetamol relieves pain by elevation of the pain threshold and reduces fever by acting on the on the heat-regulating centre in your brain and Phenylephrine constricts blood vessels and reduces the blood flow to certain areas, thus decreasing swelling and allowing nasal and respiratory passages to open up.
usageDetails:
How to use FEBREX PLUS TABLET

Take FEBREX PLUS TABLET as advised by your physician. It can be taken with or without food.

For Tablet, Capsule: Swallow FEBREX PLUS TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse the medicine in the specified quantity of water as mentioned in the label. Consume the medicine immediately after reconstitution.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of the infection.

Spray Otrivin OXY 1-2 times in each nostril up to 3 times daily. Do not use for more than 7 days continuously. It continues to act up to 12 hours and thus provides quick and long-lasting relief from blocked nose.

Otrivin OXY Fast Relief Adult Nasal Spray 10ml starts to unblock the nose within 25 seconds. It opens up the nasal passages and allows you to breathe normally. Because it is applied directly inside the nose.

The most common side effects of Otrivin OXY Fast Relief Adult Nasal Spray 10ml are nasal dryness and discomfort, sneezing, headache, nausea or dizziness. Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects persists for a longer duration.

warnings.details: There are no well-controlled studies in pregnant women assessing the effects of oxymetazoline. A small study involving 12 healthy pregnant women reported that a single dose of oxymetazoline nasal spray did not affect uterine blood flow. Due to the lack of comprehensive studies, it is advisable to consult a healthcare provider before using oxymetazoline during pregnancy.

There is no available data on whether oxymetazoline passes into human breast milk. Since oxymetazoline is applied topically (nasal spray), systemic absorption is minimal, suggesting a low likelihood of significant transfer into breast milk. Due to the absence of specific data, it is recommended to consult a healthcare provider before using oxymetazoline while breastfeeding.
Do not drive or handle heavy tools or machines if you feel dizziness after using the medicine.

Otrivin OXY Fast Relief Adult Nasal Spray should be used with caution in elderly patients. Elderly individuals, especially those with hypertension, heart disease, glaucoma, or diabetes, should use Otrivin only after consulting a doctor. Since Oxymetazoline constricts blood vessels.

Before using FURAMIST NASAL SPRAY tell your doctor if you have severe liver disease, any history of eye conditions such as glaucoma (increase in pressure in the eye) or cataracts (clouding of the lens of the eye), or had nose surgery, or got an infection in your nose.

introduction:
Introduction About FLUTICLEAR NASAL SPRAY

FLUTICLEAR NASAL SPRAY contains Fluticasone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids (glucocorticoids). It is used to manage symptoms of allergic rhinitis such as stuffy, runny, or itchy nose, sneezing, itchy, red, or watery eyes in adults and children above 6 years of age.

Allergic rhinitis may be defined as an inflammatory disease of the nasal mucosa caused due to allergies caused form certain things such as pollen from grass or trees, animals (cats and dogs), house-dust mites, or moulds.

Before using FLUTICLEAR NASAL SPRAY tell your doctor if you have severe liver disease, any history of eye conditions such as glaucoma (increase in pressure in the eye) or cataracts (clouding of the lens of the eye), or had nose surgery, or got an infection in your nose.

FLUTICLEAR NASAL SPRAY should not be used in pregnant and breastfeeding women, unless advised clearly necessary by the doctor. Contact your doctor before using. FLUTICLEAR NASAL SPRAY is not recommended for use in children below 6 years of age. FLUTICLEAR NASAL SPRAY should be used with caution in elderly patients. Therefore, contact your doctor before using.

The most common side effects of using FLUTICLEAR NASAL SPRAY include nosebleeds (generally minor), nasal ulceration, headache, and shortness of breath. Contact your doctor if any of these worsen or doesn’t improve.

How FLUTICLEAR NASAL SPRAY Works

FLUTICLEAR NASAL SPRAY causes vasoconstriction (constriction of blood vessels) and has anti-inflammatory activity. It directly decreases the cells that cause inflammation such as eosinophils, monocytes, mast cells, macrophages, and dendritic cells. FLUTICLEAR NASAL SPRAY also decreases mucus gland secretions. Therefore, helps in reducing inflammation and making it easier to breathe.

Use FLUTICLEAR NASAL SPRAY as advised by your physician. It is for intranasal use only. Shake the bottle before every use. Your doctor will decide what quantity of dose you require at what frequency depending on the severity of the disease and your physical characteristics. Do not start or stop the medicine without consulting your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About OTRIVIN SALINE NASAL SPRAY

Otrivin Saline Nasal Spray is a nasal decongestant which is used to clean the nasal cavities when nose is blocked during colds or in allergic conditions, moisturises the dry or irritated nose, and help to remove nasal secretions.

It contains sodium chloride as an active ingredient that cleans out your nasal cavities to help eliminate pollutants like dust and other fine particles lingering in the air, which may cause nasal congestion.

Sodium Chloride helps to loosen the thick nasal discharge produced in the nose because of cold or allergic reaction, which makes it easier to keep nasal passages open by washing out dried and thick mucus. It also moistens dry and irritated nasal cavities caused by low humidity.

Always use Otrivin Saline Nasal Spray as directed by the physician. This medicine should not be used after the usage of any other local nasal product.

If you are using this medicine after nasal surgery or injury, consult your doctor once. Ask your doctor before using Otrivin Saline Nasal Spray during pregnancy or breastfeeding.

name: NASOMIST X Nasal Drops 10ml
introduction:
Introduction About NASOMIST X NASAL DROPS

Nasomist X is nasal decongestant nasal drops used for symptomatic relief from nasal congestion caused due to allergies and common cold. It contains a medicine called xylometazoline which works by thinning the mucus present in the nasal tract. 

Always use NASOMIST X NASAL DROPS as directed by your physician. Gently instil 1-2 drops in each nostril, one or two times daily or as directed by the physician. It is for intranasal use only. Do not use NASOMIST X NASAL DROPS for more than 7 days without consulting your doctor.

Before using NASOMIST X NASAL DROPS inform your doctor if you have diabetes, hypertension, glaucoma, hyperthyroidism, or any heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any other problems in nasal tract apart from nasal congestion such as chronic nasal inflammation with very dry nasal passages (rhinitis sicca or atrophic rhinitis).

The most common side effects of using NASOMIST X NASAL DROPS are irritation or burning sensation after application and nasal dryness. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens. Nasomist X acts faster which makes it suitable for use both in adults and in children 6 years or older. It is well tolerated in adults & children. Nasomist X is convenient and easy to use, gives better coverage.
uses: Nasal congestion
usesDetails:
Uses Of NASOMIST X NASAL DROPS
Nasal congestion
mechanismOfAction:
How NASOMIST X NASAL DROPS Works

NASOMIST X NASAL DROPS opens and clears the nasal passages. It works by narrowing down the blood vessels supplying the nasal passage. This helps swollen blood vessels of the nasal tract to return to its normal size which allows the air to pass through the nostrils more freely. It also reduces excessive nasal secretions and provides temporary relief from nasal inflammation, swelling and discomfort.
usageDetails:
How to use NASOMIST X NASAL DROPS

Always use NASOMIST X NASAL DROPS as directed by your physician. It is for intranasal use only.

For Nasal Drops: Gently instil few drops of this medicine into each nostril.  One to two drops in each nostril, one or two times daily or as directed by the physician. Clean the dropper after application.

For Nasal Spray: Insert the spray nozzle inside the affected nostril. Press the pump to release the spray and sniff at the same time. Repeat the same to the other nostril if required. Clean the nozzle after application.

To avoid possible spread of infection, this pack should only be used by a single person. Do not use NASOMIST X NASAL DROPS for more than 7 days without consulting your doctor. Discard the unused portion after 28 days of opening it.

NASOMIST X NASAL DROPS can be used in children and adolescents aged 12 years or above. You must consult your doctor before using NASOMIST X NASAL DROPS if your child is aged 6 years or above. NASOMIST X NASAL DROPS should be used with caution in elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice.

Have any problems in the nasal tract such as chronic nasal inflammation with very dry nasal passages (rhinitis sicca or atrophic rhinitis)
Have an enlarged prostate gland
Have phaeochromocytoma (a rare tumour of the adrenal glands)

Before using NASOMIST X NASAL DROPS, inform your doctor if you:

Have diabetes
Have hyperthyroidism (overactive thyroid gland)

This helps swollen blood vessels of the nasal tract to return to its normal size which allows the air to pass through the nostrils more freely. It also reduces excessive nasal secretions and provides temporary relief from nasal inflammation, swelling and discomfort.
usageDetails:
How to use XYLOFLO NASAL DROPS

Always use XYLOFLO NASAL DROPS as directed by your physician. It is for intranasal use only.

For Nasal Drops: Gently instill few drops of this medicine into each nostril.  One to two drops in each nostril, one or two times daily or as directed by the physician.Clean the dropper after application.

For Nasal Spray: Insert the spray nozzle inside the affected nostril. Press the pump to release the spray and sniff at the same time. Repeat the same to the other nostril if required. Clean the nozzle after application.

To avoid possible spread of infection, this pack should only be used by a single person. Do not use XYLOFLO NASAL DROPS for more than 7 days without consulting your doctor. Discard the unused portion after 28 days of opening it.

introduction:
Introduction About FLUTICONE FT 120MD NASAL SPRAY

FLUTICONE FT 120MD NASAL SPRAY contains Fluticasone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids (glucocorticoids). It is used to manage symptoms of allergic rhinitis such as stuffy, runny, or itchy nose, sneezing, itchy, red, or watery eyes in adults and children above 6 years of age.

Allergic rhinitis may be defined as an inflammatory disease of the nasal mucosa caused due to allergies caused form certain things such as pollen from grass or trees, animals (cats and dogs), house-dust mites, or moulds.

Before using FLUTICONE FT 120MD NASAL SPRAY tell your doctor if you have severe liver disease, any history of eye conditions such as glaucoma (increase in pressure in the eye) or cataracts (clouding of the lens of the eye), or had nose surgery, or got an infection in your nose.

FLUTICONE FT 120MD NASAL SPRAY should not be used in pregnant and breastfeeding women, unless advised clearly necessary by the doctor. Contact your doctor before using. FLUTICONE FT 120MD NASAL SPRAY is not recommended for use in children below 6 years of age. FLUTICONE FT 120MD NASAL SPRAY should be used with caution in elderly patients. Therefore, contact your doctor before using.

The most common side effects of using FLUTICONE FT 120MD NASAL SPRAY include nosebleeds (generally minor), nasal ulceration, headache, and shortness of breath. Contact your doctor if any of these worsen or doesn’t improve.

mechanismOfAction:
How FLUTICONE FT 120MD NASAL SPRAY Works

FLUTICONE FT 120MD NASAL SPRAY causes vasoconstriction (constriction of blood vessels) and has anti-inflammatory activity. It directly decreases the cells that cause inflammation such as eosinophils, monocytes, mast cells, macrophages, and dendritic cells. FLUTICONE FT 120MD NASAL SPRAY also decreases mucus gland secretions. Therefore, helps in reducing inflammation and making it easier to breathe.
usageDetails:
How to use FLUTICONE FT 120MD NASAL SPRAY

Use FLUTICONE FT 120MD NASAL SPRAY as advised by your physician. It is for intranasal use only. Shake the bottle before every use. Your doctor will decide what quantity of dose you require at what frequency depending on the severity of the disease and your physical characteristics. Do not start or stop the medicine without consulting your doctor.

NASOCLEAR REFILL PACK Nasal Wash is a nasal decongestants used for nasal irrigation and temporarily relieves symptoms associated with sinusitis, cold, flu or allergies such as sneezing, nasal stuffiness, runny nose, post nasal drip. It removes inhaled irritants (dust, pollen) and helps to loosen thick mucus and moistens nasal passages. It contains sodium bicarbonate and sodium chloride as active ingredients.

Sodium bicarbonate or sodium chloride helps to add moisture inside the nose to dissolve and soften thick or crusty mucus. This helps relieve nasal stuffiness and makes breathing easier.

Use NASOCLEAR REFILL PACK Nasal Wash exactly as advised by your doctor. It is for intranasal use only. Dissolve the contents of a sachet into 120 ml of lukewarm water. Stir completely till the components are fully dissolved. Take this solution (hypertonic saline solution) in a squeeze bottle. Pour into your nostrils by tilting your head. Proper positioning helps the liquid to flow through nose by gravity. The solution will freely flow through one nose and comes out through the other nose pulls along thick mucus, and allergens. Once completed, exhale through both noses to remove excess solution and mucus. Repeat the same process with another nostril.
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of NASOCLEAR REFILL PACK NASAL WASH

NASOCLEAR REFILL PACK Nasal Wash may cause stinging if the nose is very dry and irritated in some individuals. Consult your doctor if you experience any unusual symptoms while using NASOCLEAR REFILL PACK Nasal Wash.

introduction:
Introduction About NAZOMAC FF 0.055% NASAL SPRAY

NAZOMAC FF 0.055% NASAL SPRAY contains Fluticasone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids (glucocorticoids). It is used to manage symptoms of allergic rhinitis such as stuffy, runny, or itchy nose, sneezing, itchy, red, or watery eyes in adults and children above 6 years of age.

Allergic rhinitis may be defined as an inflammatory disease of the nasal mucosa caused due to allergies caused form certain things such as pollen from grass or trees, animals (cats and dogs), house-dust mites, or moulds.

Before using NAZOMAC FF 0.055% NASAL SPRAY tell your doctor if you have severe liver disease, any history of eye conditions such as glaucoma (increase in pressure in the eye) or cataracts (clouding of the lens of the eye), or had nose surgery, or got an infection in your nose.

NAZOMAC FF 0.055% NASAL SPRAY should not be used in pregnant and breastfeeding women, unless advised clearly necessary by the doctor. Contact your doctor before using. NAZOMAC FF 0.055% NASAL SPRAY is not recommended for use in children below 6 years of age. NAZOMAC FF 0.055% NASAL SPRAY should be used with caution in elderly patients. Therefore, contact your doctor before using.

The most common side effects of using NAZOMAC FF 0.055% NASAL SPRAY include nosebleeds (generally minor), nasal ulceration, headache, and shortness of breath. Contact your doctor if any of these worsen or doesn’t improve.

mechanismOfAction:
How NAZOMAC FF 0.055% NASAL SPRAY Works

NAZOMAC FF 0.055% NASAL SPRAY causes vasoconstriction (constriction of blood vessels) and has anti-inflammatory activity. It directly decreases the cells that cause inflammation such as eosinophils, monocytes, mast cells, macrophages, and dendritic cells. NAZOMAC FF 0.055% NASAL SPRAY also decreases mucus gland secretions. Therefore, helps in reducing inflammation and making it easier to breathe.
usageDetails:
How to use NAZOMAC FF 0.055% NASAL SPRAY

Use NAZOMAC FF 0.055% NASAL SPRAY as advised by your physician. It is for intranasal use only. Shake the bottle before every use. Your doctor will decide what quantity of dose you require at what frequency depending on the severity of the disease and your physical characteristics. Do not start or stop the medicine without consulting your doctor.

name: Mucoris Adult Nasal Spray 10ml
introduction:
Introduction About MUCORIS ADULT NASAL SPRAY

MUCORIS ADULT NASAL SPRAY is paediatric nasal drop used for symptomatic relief from nasal congestion in children. MUCORIS ADULT NASAL SPRAY reduces nasal congestion, excessive nasal secretion and restores normal breathing. It contains a medicine called xylometazoline which works by thinning the mucus present in the nasal tract. 

Always use MUCORIS ADULT NASAL SPRAY as directed by your physician.One to two drops in each nostril, one or two times daily or as directed by the physician. It is for intranasal use only. Do not use MUCORIS ADULT NASAL SPRAY for more than 7 days without consulting your doctor.

Before using MUCORIS ADULT NASAL SPRAY inform your doctor if you have diabetes, hypertension, glaucoma, hyperthyroidism, or any heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any other problems in nasal tract apart from nasal congestion such as chronic nasal inflammation with very dry nasal passages (rhinitis sicca or atrophic rhinitis).

The most common side effects of using MUCORIS ADULT NASAL SPRAY are irritation or burning sensation after application and nasal dryness. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Nasal congestion
usesDetails:
Uses Of MUCORIS ADULT NASAL SPRAY
Nasal congestion
mechanismOfAction:
How MUCORIS ADULT NASAL SPRAY Works

MUCORIS ADULT NASAL SPRAY opens and clears the nasal passages. It works by narrowing down the blood vessels supplying the nasal passage. This helps swollen blood vessels of the nasal tract to return to its normal size which allows the air to pass through the nostrils more freely. It also reduces excessive nasal secretions and provides temporary relief from nasal inflammation, swelling and discomfort.
usageDetails:
How to use MUCORIS ADULT NASAL SPRAY

Always use MUCORIS ADULT NASAL SPRAY as directed by your physician. It is for intranasal use only.

For Nasal Drops: Gently instill few drops of this medicine into each nostril.  One to two drops in each nostril, one or two times daily or as directed by the physician.Clean the dropper after application.

For Nasal Spray: Insert the spray nozzle inside the affected nostril. Press the pump to release the spray and sniff at the same time. Repeat the same to the other nostril if required. Clean the nozzle after application.

To avoid possible spread of infection, this pack should only be used by a single person. Do not use MUCORIS ADULT NASAL SPRAY for more than 7 days without consulting your doctor. Discard the unused portion after 28 days of opening it.

usageDetails:
How to use SINOZAP X ADULT NASAL SPRAY
Step-by-Step Guide to Use
Wash Your Hands
Begin by cleaning your hands with soap and water to avoid introducing contaminants into the nasal passages
Shake the Bottle (If Advised)
Read the label instructions carefully. If the product recommends shaking, gently shake the bottle to ensure uniform consistency
Remove the Protective Cap
Uncap the spray bottle and make sure the nozzle is clean. Wipe it with a sterile tissue if necessary
Prime the Spray (First Use or After Gaps)
If using the spray for the first time or after a few days, press down the pump until a fine mist is released. This ensures the spray mechanism is working correctly
Position Yourself Comfortably
Tilt your head slightly forward. Avoid tilting it backward to prevent the liquid from running into the throat
Insert the Nozzle Gently
Place the nozzle just inside the nostril. Avoid inserting it deeply. Hold the opposite nostril closed using a finger
Spray and Breathe Lightly
Press the pump once while gently inhaling through the nose. Breathe out through the mouth
Repeat for the Other Nostril (If Needed)
Follow the same steps for the other nostril if instructed for both sides.
Wipe and Recap
After use, wipe the nozzle clean and securely replace the protective cap.
Wash Hands Again
Finish by washing your hands to maintain hygiene.
How many sprays should I use per nostril?

Typically, 1 to 2 sprays per nostril are recommended per application. Always follow the dosage instructions on the product label or as advised by a healthcare professional.

Should I breathe in while spraying nasal spray?

Yes, it is best to gently inhale through your nose while pressing the spray pump. This helps the solution reach the nasal passages effectively.

How long should I wait between nasal spray uses?

If using multiple nasal sprays or doses, wait about 5 to 10 minutes between uses to allow each spray to work properly and avoid dilution.

Usage tips for best results
Use the spray while upright, avoid lying down immediately after application
Do not share your nasal spray with others to reduce contamination
Avoid blowing your nose immediately after use
If used in combination with other nasal products, wait 5–10 minutes between applications unless directed otherwise
Suggested Usage Frequency
May be used once or multiple times daily as per label recommendation
Avoid exceeding the recommended number of sprays per day

Do not insert the nozzle too deeply into the nostrils to prevent irritation or injury
Avoid forceful spraying or pressing the pump repeatedly at once. Use a gentle, steady spray

Are saline nasal sprays safe for everyone?

Saline nasal sprays like SINOZAP X are generally safe for most people, including adults and children. Since they contain only sterile saline solution without active ingredients, they are suitable for regular use to support nasal hygiene. However, individuals with specific nasal conditions or allergies should consult a healthcare professional before use.

Does nasal spray have preservatives?

Some nasal sprays include preservatives to maintain sterility and manage microbial growth. SINOZAP X is formulated with or without preservatives depending on the variant. Always check the product label or packaging for details. Preservative-free options are also available for sensitive users.

Can saline spray cause nosebleeds?

When used correctly, saline sprays are unlikely to cause nosebleeds. Overuse, incorrect application, or spraying too deeply inside the nostrils may irritate the nasal lining and cause minor bleeding. Following the recommended usage instructions helps minimize this risk.

Is there any rebound effect with non-medicated sprays?

Unlike medicated nasal sprays, sterile isotonic saline sprays like SINOZAP X do not cause rebound congestion or dependency. They work by gently moisturizing and cleansing the nasal passages without affecting blood vessels.

introduction:
Introduction About VITAL STEAM INHALATION CAPSULE

Vital Steam Inhalation Capsule is a decongestant used to relieve stuffiness, an irritated nose, and heaviness in the head due to a cold. It contains camphor, chlorothymol, eucalyptol, menthol, and terpineol as active ingredients that work by clearing blockages in the nose.

Menthol is mainly used to relieve symptoms of bronchitis, sinusitis, and similar conditions. Eucalyptol kills bacteria and eases breathing difficulties in people with croup (upper airway infection causing barking cough), asthma, and bronchitis.

Terpineol exerts anti-infective effects. Chlorothymol is a phenolic antiseptic that has a special use in symptomatic relief from the common cold. Camphor acts as a rubefacient and mild painkiller.

Use Vital Steam Inhalation Capsule as advised by your physician. It is for inhalational use only. Avoid direct contact with the eyes and nostrils. Do not ingest. It should not be used in neonates or patients with renal calculi. Ask your doctor before using Vital Steam Inhalation Capsule during pregnancy and breastfeeding.

name: Freeair Nasal Spray 6Gm
introduction:
Introduction About FREEAIR NASAL SPRAY

FREEAIR NASAL SPRAY contains Fluticasone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids (glucocorticoids). It is used to manage symptoms of allergic rhinitis such as stuffy, runny, or itchy nose, sneezing, itchy, red, or watery eyes in adults and children above 6 years of age.

Allergic rhinitis may be defined as an inflammatory disease of the nasal mucosa caused due to allergies caused form certain things such as pollen from grass or trees, animals (cats and dogs), house-dust mites, or moulds.

Before using FREEAIR NASAL SPRAY tell your doctor if you have severe liver disease, any history of eye conditions such as glaucoma (increase in pressure in the eye) or cataracts (clouding of the lens of the eye), or had nose surgery, or got an infection in your nose.

FREEAIR NASAL SPRAY should not be used in pregnant and breastfeeding women, unless advised clearly necessary by the doctor. Contact your doctor before using. FREEAIR NASAL SPRAY is not recommended for use in children below 6 years of age. FREEAIR NASAL SPRAY should be used with caution in elderly patients. Therefore, contact your doctor before using.

The most common side effects of using FREEAIR NASAL SPRAY include nosebleeds (generally minor), nasal ulceration, headache, and shortness of breath. Contact your doctor if any of these worsen or doesn’t improve.

mechanismOfAction:
How FREEAIR NASAL SPRAY Works

FREEAIR NASAL SPRAY causes vasoconstriction (constriction of blood vessels) and has anti-inflammatory activity. It directly decreases the cells that cause inflammation such as eosinophils, monocytes, mast cells, macrophages, and dendritic cells. FREEAIR NASAL SPRAY also decreases mucus gland secretions. Therefore, helps in reducing inflammation and making it easier to breathe.
usageDetails:
How to use FREEAIR NASAL SPRAY

Use FREEAIR NASAL SPRAY as advised by your physician. It is for intranasal use only. Shake the bottle before every use. Your doctor will decide what quantity of dose you require at what frequency depending on the severity of the disease and your physical characteristics. Do not start or stop the medicine without consulting your doctor.

name: Nasowash Sachet 7.8Gm
introduction:
Introduction About NASOWASH SACHET
What is Nasowash Sachet 7.8Gm?

Nasowash Sachet 7.8Gm is a saline nasal wash designed to clear nasal passages and provide relief from sinus congestion and allergies.

Nasowash Sachet 7.8Gm clears nasal congestion effectively, helps in sinus and allergy relief and safe and easy to use.

Mix the Nasowash Sachet 7.8Gm sachet with sterile water and use a neti pot or nasal spray bottle to irrigate nasal passages. Consult your doctor if you experience any side effects like sneezing or stinging of nose.
mechanismOfAction:
How NASOWASH SACHET Works
How Nasowash Sachet 7.8Gm works for Sinus relief:
1. Clears mucus and blockages:
The saline solution flushes out excess mucus, allergens, and irritants from the nasal passages
Helps in unclogging sinuses, allowing better airflow and reducing sinus pressure
2. Reduces inflammation and irritation:
The sodium chloride and sodium bicarbonate help maintain the nasal pH balance, reducing inflammation
Xylitol, if present, has antimicrobial properties that help manage bacterial infections
3. Hydrates and soothes the nasal lining:
Manages nasal dryness by keeping the mucous membranes moist
Soothes irritation caused by pollution, smoke, allergens, or infections
4. Improves sinus drainage:
Helps loosen thick mucus, making it easier to drain from the sinuses
Reduces post-nasal drip, a common issue with sinus infections
5. Manage sinus infections:
Regular nasal rinsing removes bacteria and viruses, reducing the risk of sinus infections and allergies
What is Nasal irrigation? Benefits & Best practices

Nasal irrigation (nasal rinse, sinus rinse, or saline lavage) is a process of flushing out the nasal passages using a sterile saline solution. It helps clear mucus, allergens, and irritants, promoting better nasal hygiene and sinus health.

Benefits of Nasal irrigation:
Clears nasal congestion
Reduces allergy symptoms
Manages sinus infections
Moisturizes dry nasal passages
Improves breathing & sleep quality
Best practices for nasal irrigation
Use sterile water – Always use distilled, boiled, or sterile water to avoid infections
Maintain proper saline concentration – use pre-measured saline sachets like Nasowash sachet 7.8gm to ensure the right balance
Use the right technique – tilt your head and use a neti pot, nasal spray, or squeeze bottle for irrigation
Do not overuse – once or twice daily is ideal, excessive rinsing may irritate the nasal lining
Keep equipment clean – wash and dry your neti pot or squeeze bottle after every use to manage bacterial buildup
usageInstructions: Empty the sachet: Pour the entire contents of one 7.8g Nasowash sachet into a clean nasal irrigation device, such as the Nasowash squeeze bottle
Add lukewarm water: Fill the bottle with previously boiled and cooled lukewarm water up to the 200 ml mark. Avoid using boiling or unsterilized water
Mix the solution: Secure the cap and shake the bottle gently until the powder dissolves completely, forming a uniform saline solution
Frequency: Perform nasal irrigation once or twice daily, or as directed by a healthcare professional

FAQs & Myth-busting content
1. Can I use Nasowash sachet daily? is it safe?

Benefits of Daily use

Clears mucus & allergens – Helps flush out dust, pollen, and pollutants
Manages sinus infections – Reduces bacterial buildup in the nasal passages
Improves breathing – Keeps nasal passages open and moist
Reduces nasal congestion – Helps manage allergies and colds
Does Nasal irrigation damage the nose?
Myth 1: Nasal irrigation damages the nose - Truth: When done correctly, nasal irrigation does not damage nasal tissues. Instead, it helps remove mucus, allergens, and pollutants, keeping your nasal passages healthy
Myth 2: It causes dependency and your nose will stop working naturally - Truth: Unlike nasal sprays with decongestants (which can cause rebound congestion), saline nasal irrigation does not create dependency. You can stop at any time without side effects
Myth 3: It is only for people with sinus infections - Truth: While great for sinus relief, nasal irrigation is also beneficial for allergy sufferers, frequent travelers, and people exposed to dust/pollution. It improves nasal hygiene for everyone
Can Nasowash Sachet 7.8Gm be used for children? Safety precautions for children
Consult a pediatrician first, especially for children under 2 years old
Use the right saline concentration - mix the sachet in sterile or distilled water
Use a child-friendly nasal rinse device - gentle squeeze bottle or dropper is best for younger kids
Positioning matters - Have the child lean forward slightly to prevent choking
Do not force the process - if the child resists, try again later with a calmer approach

introduction:
Introduction About OXYNASOCAN NASAL DROPS

OXYNASOCAN NASAL DROPS contains Oxymetazoline which belongs to the group of medicines called Nasal decongestants. It is used in adults and in adolescents (aged 12 years or above) to provide relief from nasal congestion, itching and discomfort caused due to common cold, sinusitis (inflammation of the sinuses) or allergic rhinitis (an allergic condition).

Always use OXYNASOCAN NASAL DROPS as directed by your physician. It is for intranasal use only. Do not use OXYNASOCAN NASAL DROPS for more than 7 days without consulting your doctor.

Before using OXYNASOCAN NASAL DROPS inform your doctor if you have diabetes, hypertension, glaucoma, hyperthyroidism, or any heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any other problems in nasal tract apart from nasal congestion such as chronic nasal inflammation with very dry nasal passages (rhinitis sicca or atrophic rhinitis).

Consult your doctor before using OXYNASOCAN NASAL DROPS if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of using OXYNASOCAN NASAL DROPS are irritation or burning sensation after application and nasal dryness. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How OXYNASOCAN NASAL DROPS Works

OXYNASOCAN NASAL DROPS opens and clears the nasal passages. It works by narrowing down the blood vessels supplying the nasal passage. This helps swollen blood vessels of the nasal tract to return to its normal size which allows the air to pass through the nostrils more freely. It also reduces the excessive nasal secretions and provides temporary relief from nasal inflammation, swelling and discomfort.
usageDetails:
How to use OXYNASOCAN NASAL DROPS

Always use OXYNASOCAN NASAL DROPS as directed by your physician. It is for intranasal use only.

For Nasal Drops: Gently instil few drops of this medicine into each nostril. Clean the dropper after application.

For Nasal Spray: Insert the spray nozzle inside the affected nostril. Press the pump to release the spray and sniff at the same time. Repeat the same to the other nostril if required. Clean the nozzle after application.

To avoid possible spread of infection, this pack should only be used by a single person. Do not use OXYNASOCAN NASAL DROPS for more than 7 days without consulting your doctor. Discard the unused portion after 28 days of opening it.

introduction:
Introduction About MOMENTA NASAL SPRAY

MOMENTA NASAL SPRAY contains Mometasone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids. MOMENTA NASAL SPRAY is used to manage the symptoms of hay fever (seasonal allergic rhinitis) and perennial rhinitis in adults and children aged 2 and older. This medicine is also used to manage nasal polyps in adults aged 18 and over.

Hay Fever is an allergic reaction which occurs due to breathing in pollen from trees, grasses, weeds, molds and fungal spores generally characterized by blocked or runny nose, sneezing and coughing.

Perennial rhinitis is an inflammatory condition which occurs due to sensitivity to a variety of things such as house dust mite, animal hair, feathers and certain foods characterized by symptoms such as blocked nose, sneezing, itching that might occur for an hour or more on most days throughout the year.

Nasal polyps are small growths on the lining of the nose which usually affects both nostrils generally characterized by runny nose, and stuffiness.

Avoid using MOMENTA NASAL SPRAY, if you are allergic to Mometasone, and or have an unmanageed infection in your nose such as herpes, recent injury or operation on your nose.

Before using MOMENTA NASAL SPRAY, inform your doctor if you have kidney, or liver disease. MOMENTA NASAL SPRAY should be used in pregnant women only if it is clearly necessary. It should be used with caution in breastfeeding women.

Your doctor will give the right dose depends on your child’s age, body weight and disease condition. Consult your doctor before using MOMENTA NASAL SPRAY.

The most common side effects of using MOMENTA NASAL SPRAY are headache, sneezing, nose bleeds, sore nose or throat, ulcers in the nose and or respiratory tract infection. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms gets worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About FLUTIWAYS NASAL SPRAY

FLUTIWAYS NASAL SPRAY contains Fluticasone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids (glucocorticoids). It is used to manage symptoms of allergic rhinitis such as stuffy, runny, or itchy nose, sneezing, itchy, red, or watery eyes in adults and children above 6 years of age.

Allergic rhinitis may be defined as an inflammatory disease of the nasal mucosa caused due to allergies caused form certain things such as pollen from grass or trees, animals (cats and dogs), house-dust mites, or moulds.

Before using FLUTIWAYS NASAL SPRAY tell your doctor if you have severe liver disease, any history of eye conditions such as glaucoma (increase in pressure in the eye) or cataracts (clouding of the lens of the eye), or had nose surgery, or got an infection in your nose.

FLUTIWAYS NASAL SPRAY should not be used in pregnant and breastfeeding women, unless advised clearly necessary by the doctor. Contact your doctor before using. introduction:
Introduction About SINAREST NASAL DROPS

SINAREST NASAL DROPS contains Oxymetazoline which belongs to the group of medicines called Nasal decongestants. It is used in adults and in adolescents (aged 12 years or above) to provide relief from nasal congestion, itching and discomfort caused due to common cold, sinusitis (inflammation of the sinuses) or allergic rhinitis (an allergic condition).

Always use SINAREST NASAL DROPS as directed by your physician. It is for intranasal use only. Do not use SINAREST NASAL DROPS for more than 7 days without consulting your doctor.

Before using SINAREST NASAL DROPS inform your doctor if you have diabetes, hypertension, glaucoma, hyperthyroidism, or any heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any other problems in nasal tract apart from nasal congestion such as chronic nasal inflammation with very dry nasal passages (rhinitis sicca or atrophic rhinitis).

Consult your doctor before using SINAREST NASAL DROPS if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of using SINAREST NASAL DROPS are irritation or burning sensation after application and nasal dryness. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

usesDetails:
Uses Of SINAREST NASAL DROPS

It is used in adults and in adolescents (aged 12 years or above) to provide relief from:

Nasal congestion (blocked nose)
Symptoms of Allergic rhinitis (such as nasal itching, discomfort, runny nose)

mechanismOfAction:
How SINAREST NASAL DROPS Works

SINAREST NASAL DROPS opens and clears the nasal passages. It works by narrowing down the blood vessels supplying the nasal passage. This helps swollen blood vessels of the nasal tract to return to its normal size which allows the air to pass through the nostrils more freely. It also reduces the excessive nasal secretions and provides temporary relief from nasal inflammation, swelling and discomfort.
usageDetails:
How to use SINAREST NASAL DROPS

Always use SINAREST NASAL DROPS as directed by your physician. It is for intranasal use only.

For Nasal Drops: Gently instil few drops of this medicine into each nostril. Clean the dropper after application.

For Nasal Spray: Insert the spray nozzle inside the affected nostril. Press the pump to release the spray and sniff at the same time. Repeat the same to the other nostril if required. Clean the nozzle after application.

To avoid possible spread of infection, this pack should only be used by a single person. Do not use SINAREST NASAL DROPS for more than 7 days without consulting your doctor. Discard the unused portion after 28 days of opening it.

SINAREST NASAL DROPS should be used with caution in patients with heart disease (such as hypertension, prolonged QT syndrome). Therefore, consult your doctor before using it.

name: Metaspray Nasal Spray 100Md
introduction:
Introduction About METASPRAY NASAL SPRAY

METASPRAY NASAL SPRAY contains Mometasone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids. METASPRAY NASAL SPRAY is used to manage the symptoms of hay fever (seasonal allergic rhinitis) and perennial rhinitis in adults and children aged 2 and older. This medicine is also used to manage nasal polyps in adults aged 18 and over.

Hay Fever is an allergic reaction which occurs due to breathing in pollen from trees, grasses, weeds, molds and fungal spores generally characterized by blocked or runny nose, sneezing and coughing.

Perennial rhinitis is an inflammatory condition which occurs due to sensitivity to a variety of things such as house dust mite, animal hair, feathers and certain foods characterized by symptoms such as blocked nose, sneezing, itching that might occur for an hour or more on most days throughout the year.

Nasal polyps are small growths on the lining of the nose which usually affects both nostrils generally characterized by runny nose, and stuffiness.

Avoid using METASPRAY NASAL SPRAY, if you are allergic to Mometasone, and or have an unmanageed infection in your nose such as herpes, recent injury or operation on your nose.

Before using METASPRAY NASAL SPRAY, inform your doctor if you have kidney, or liver disease. METASPRAY NASAL SPRAY should be used in pregnant women only if it is clearly necessary. It should be used with caution in breastfeeding women.

Your doctor will give the right dose depends on your child’s age, body weight and disease condition. Consult your doctor before using METASPRAY NASAL SPRAY.

name: ZYLO Nasal Drops 10ml
introduction:
Introduction About ZYLO NASAL DROPS

ZYLO NASAL DROPS is paediatric nasal drop used for symptomatic relief from nasal congestion in children. ZYLO NASAL DROPS reduces nasal congestion, excessive nasal secretion and restores normal breathing. It contains a medicine called xylometazoline which works by thinning the mucus present in the nasal tract. 

Always use ZYLO NASAL DROPS as directed by your physician.One to two drops in each nostril, one or two times daily or as directed by the physician. It is for intranasal use only. Do not use ZYLO NASAL DROPS for more than 7 days without consulting your doctor.

Before using ZYLO NASAL DROPS inform your doctor if you have diabetes, hypertension, glaucoma, hyperthyroidism, or any heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any other problems in nasal tract apart from nasal congestion such as chronic nasal inflammation with very dry nasal passages (rhinitis sicca or atrophic rhinitis).

The most common side effects of using ZYLO NASAL DROPS are irritation or burning sensation after application and nasal dryness. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Nasal congestion
usesDetails:
Uses Of ZYLO NASAL DROPS
Nasal congestion
mechanismOfAction:
How ZYLO NASAL DROPS Works

ZYLO NASAL DROPS opens and clears the nasal passages. It works by narrowing down the blood vessels supplying the nasal passage. This helps swollen blood vessels of the nasal tract to return to its normal size which allows the air to pass through the nostrils more freely. It also reduces excessive nasal secretions and provides temporary relief from nasal inflammation, swelling and discomfort.
usageDetails:
How to use ZYLO NASAL DROPS

Always use ZYLO NASAL DROPS as directed by your physician. It is for intranasal use only.

For Nasal Drops: Gently instill few drops of this medicine into each nostril.  One to two drops in each nostril, one or two times daily or as directed by the physician.Clean the dropper after application.

For Nasal Spray: Insert the spray nozzle inside the affected nostril. Press the pump to release the spray and sniff at the same time. Repeat the same to the other nostril if required. Clean the nozzle after application.

To avoid possible spread of infection, this pack should only be used by a single person. Do not use ZYLO NASAL DROPS for more than 7 days without consulting your doctor. Discard the unused portion after 28 days of opening it.

name: Nasowash Starter Kit 1's
introduction:
Introduction About NASOWASH STARTER KIT

Nasowash Starter Kit is a sterile non-medicated, preservative free saline irrigation kit which is used for nasal and sinus washing. It contains Sodium chloride that helps to increase moisture inside the nose by dissolving the soft thick or crusty mucous. Xylitol helps to make the nasal membrane slippery thereby fighting against the pathogens inside the nasal cavity.

Sodium chloride works by cleaning the mucous, allergens, crusts and air pollutants there by providing a moisturizing effect inside the nose. This helps to relieve stuffiness and makes the breathing easier. It also works by removing inflammatory mediators (such as histamines, leukotrienes, prostaglandins) which causes nasal and sinus inflammation.

Always use Nasowash Starter Kit as advised by your physician. Do not exceed the recommended dosage. Empty the entire contents of one Nasowash kit into the Nasowash squeeze bottle. Pour previously boiled, lukewarm water into the bottle up to the 200 ml mark as directed by the physician. Do not use boiling hot water. Screw the cap onto the bottle and gently shake until powder dissolves. Use this solution to wash the nasal passages and sinus cavity as instructed in the starter kit.

name: RYALTRIS MONO Nasal Spray 120md
introduction:
Introduction About RYALTRIS MONO NASAL SPRAY

RYALTRIS MONO NASAL SPRAY contains Mometasone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids. RYALTRIS MONO NASAL SPRAY is used to manage the symptoms of hay fever (seasonal allergic rhinitis) and perennial rhinitis in adults and children aged 2 and older. This medicine is also used to manage nasal polyps in adults aged 18 and over.

Hay Fever is an allergic reaction which occurs due to breathing in pollen from trees, grasses, weeds, molds and fungal spores generally characterized by blocked or runny nose, sneezing and coughing.

Perennial rhinitis is an inflammatory condition which occurs due to sensitivity to a variety of things such as house dust mite, animal hair, feathers and certain foods characterized by symptoms such as blocked nose, sneezing, itching that might occur for an hour or more on most days throughout the year.

Nasal polyps are small growths on the lining of the nose which usually affects both nostrils generally characterized by runny nose, and stuffiness.

Avoid using RYALTRIS MONO NASAL SPRAY, if you are allergic to Mometasone, and or have an unmanageed infection in your nose such as herpes, recent injury or operation on your nose.

Before using RYALTRIS MONO NASAL SPRAY, inform your doctor if you have kidney, or liver disease. RYALTRIS MONO NASAL SPRAY should be used in pregnant women only if it is clearly necessary. It should be used with caution in breastfeeding women.

Your doctor will give the right dose depends on your child’s age, body weight and disease condition. Consult your doctor before using RYALTRIS MONO NASAL SPRAY.

The most common side effects of using RYALTRIS MONO NASAL SPRAY are headache, sneezing, nose bleeds, sore nose or throat, ulcers in the nose and or respiratory tract infection. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms gets worsen.

Introduction About OTRIZEST 0.1% NASAL SPRAY

OTRIZEST 0.1% NASAL SPRAY is paediatric nasal drop used for symptomatic relief from nasal congestion in children. OTRIZEST 0.1% NASAL SPRAY reduces nasal congestion, excessive nasal secretion and restores normal breathing. It contains a medicine called xylometazoline which works by thinning the mucus present in the nasal tract. 

Always use OTRIZEST 0.1% NASAL SPRAY as directed by your physician.One to two drops in each nostril, one or two times daily or as directed by the physician. It is for intranasal use only. Do not use OTRIZEST 0.1% NASAL SPRAY for more than 7 days without consulting your doctor.

Before using OTRIZEST 0.1% NASAL SPRAY inform your doctor if you have diabetes, hypertension, glaucoma, hyperthyroidism, or any heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any other problems in nasal tract apart from nasal congestion such as chronic nasal inflammation with very dry nasal passages (rhinitis sicca or atrophic rhinitis).

The most common side effects of using OTRIZEST 0.1% NASAL SPRAY are irritation or burning sensation after application and nasal dryness. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

name: Fluticone Nasal Spray 12ml
introduction:
Introduction About FLUTICONE NASAL SPRAY

FLUTICONE NASAL SPRAY contains Fluticasone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids (glucocorticoids). It is used to manage symptoms of allergic rhinitis such as stuffy, runny, or itchy nose, sneezing, itchy, red, or watery eyes in adults and children above 6 years of age.

Allergic rhinitis may be defined as an inflammatory disease of the nasal mucosa caused due to allergies caused form certain things such as pollen from grass or trees, animals (cats and dogs), house-dust mites, or moulds.

Before using FLUTICONE NASAL SPRAY tell your doctor if you have severe liver disease, any history of eye conditions such as glaucoma (increase in pressure in the eye) or cataracts (clouding of the lens of the eye), or had nose surgery, or got an infection in your nose.

FLUTICONE NASAL SPRAY should not be used in pregnant and breastfeeding women, unless advised clearly necessary by the doctor. Contact your doctor before using. FLUTICONE NASAL SPRAY is not recommended for use in children below 6 years of age. FLUTICONE NASAL SPRAY should be used with caution in elderly patients. Therefore, contact your doctor before using.

The most common side effects of using FLUTICONE NASAL SPRAY include nosebleeds (generally minor), nasal ulceration, headache, and shortness of breath. Contact your doctor if any of these worsen or doesn’t improve.

usesDetails:
Uses Of FLUTICONE NASAL SPRAY
Manages symptoms of allergic rhinitis such as stuffy, runny, or itchy nose, sneezing, itchy, red, or watery eyes in adults and children above 6 years of age
mechanismOfAction:
How FLUTICONE NASAL SPRAY Works

FLUTICONE NASAL SPRAY causes vasoconstriction (constriction of blood vessels) and has anti-inflammatory activity. It directly decreases the cells that cause inflammation such as eosinophils, monocytes, mast cells, macrophages, and dendritic cells. FLUTICONE NASAL SPRAY also decreases mucus gland secretions. Therefore, helps in reducing inflammation and making it easier to breathe.
usageDetails:
How to use FLUTICONE NASAL SPRAY

Use FLUTICONE NASAL SPRAY as advised by your physician. It is for intranasal use only. Shake the bottle before every use. Your doctor will decide what quantity of dose you require at what frequency depending on the severity of the disease and your physical characteristics. Do not start or stop the medicine without consulting your doctor.

Blurred vision or other visual disturbances

name: SINOZAP O ADULT Nasal Spray 10ml
introduction:
Introduction About SINOZAP O ADULT NASAL SPRAY

SINOZAP O ADULT Nasal Spray is used in adults and adolescents (aged 12 years or older) to provide relief from nasal congestion, itching, and discomfort caused by the common cold, sinusitis (inflammation of the sinuses), or symptoms of allergic rhinitis (such as nasal itching, discomfort, and runny nose). It contains Oxymetazoline, which belongs to the group of medicines called Nasal decongestants that work by narrowing down the blood vessels supplying the nasal passage. This helps swollen blood vessels in the nasal tract return to their normal size, which allows air to pass through the nostrils more freely. It also reduces excessive nasal secretions and provides temporary relief from nasal inflammation, swelling, and discomfort.

Always use SINOZAP O ADULT Nasal Spray as directed by your physician. It is for intranasal use only. Do not use SINOZAP O ADULT Nasal Spray for more than 7 days without consulting your doctor.

Before using SINOZAP O ADULT Nasal Spray, inform your doctor if you have diabetes, hypertension, glaucoma, hyperthyroidism, or any heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any other problems in the nasal tract apart from nasal congestion, such as chronic nasal inflammation with very dry nasal passages (rhinitis sicca or atrophic rhinitis).

Consult your doctor before using SINOZAP O ADULT Nasal Spray if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of using SINOZAP O ADULT Nasal Spray are irritation or burning sensations after application and nasal dryness. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

SINOZAP O ADULT Nasal Spray opens and clears the nasal passages. It works by narrowing down the blood vessels supplying the nasal passage. It also reduces excessive nasal secretions and provides temporary relief from nasal inflammation, swelling, and discomfort.
usageDetails:
How to use SINOZAP O ADULT NASAL SPRAY

Always use SINOZAP O ADULT Nasal Spray as directed by your physician. It is for intranasal use only.

For Nasal Drops: Gently instil a few drops of this medicine into each nostril. Clean the dropper after application.

For nasal spray: Insert the spray nozzle inside the affected nostril. Press the pump to release the spray and sniff at the same time. Repeat the same for the other nostril if required. Clean the nozzle after application.

To avoid the possible spread of infection, this pack should only be used by a single person. Do not use SINOZAP O ADULT Nasal Spray for more than 7 days without consulting your doctor. Discard the unused portion after 28 days of opening it.
