introduction:
Introduction About RHINOFIT F 120MD NASAL SPRAY

RHINOFIT F 120MD NASAL SPRAY contains Fluticasone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids (glucocorticoids). It is used to manage symptoms of allergic rhinitis such as stuffy, runny, or itchy nose, sneezing, itchy, red, or watery eyes in adults and children above 6 years of age.

Allergic rhinitis may be defined as an inflammatory disease of the nasal mucosa caused due to allergies caused form certain things such as pollen from grass or trees, animals (cats and dogs), house-dust mites, or moulds.

Before using RHINOFIT F 120MD NASAL SPRAY tell your doctor if you have severe liver disease, any history of eye conditions such as glaucoma (increase in pressure in the eye) or cataracts (clouding of the lens of the eye), or had nose surgery, or got an infection in your nose.

RHINOFIT F 120MD NASAL SPRAY should not be used in pregnant and breastfeeding women, unless advised clearly necessary by the doctor. Contact your doctor before using. RHINOFIT F 120MD NASAL SPRAY is not recommended for use in children below 6 years of age. RHINOFIT F 120MD NASAL SPRAY should be used with caution in elderly patients. Therefore, contact your doctor before using.

The most common side effects of using RHINOFIT F 120MD NASAL SPRAY include nosebleeds (generally minor), nasal ulceration, headache, and shortness of breath. Contact your doctor if any of these worsen or doesn’t improve.

How RHINOFIT F 120MD NASAL SPRAY Works

RHINOFIT F 120MD NASAL SPRAY causes vasoconstriction (constriction of blood vessels) and has anti-inflammatory activity. It directly decreases the cells that cause inflammation such as eosinophils, monocytes, mast cells, macrophages, and dendritic cells. RHINOFIT F 120MD NASAL SPRAY also decreases mucus gland secretions. Therefore, helps in reducing inflammation and making it easier to breathe.

Your doctor will decide what quantity of dose you require at what frequency depending on the severity of the disease and your physical characteristics. Do not start or stop the medicine without consulting your doctor.

It directly decreases the cells that cause inflammation such as eosinophils, monocytes, mast cells, macrophages, and dendritic cells. SPIROFLUT 27.5MCG NASAL SPRAY also decreases mucus gland secretions. Therefore, helps in reducing inflammation and making it easier to breathe.

Your doctor will decide what quantity of dose you require at what frequency depending on the severity of the disease and your physical characteristics. Do not start or stop the medicine without consulting your doctor.

Introduction About FLORESP NASAL SPRAY

FLORESP NASAL SPRAY contains Fluticasone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids (glucocorticoids). It is used to manage symptoms of allergic rhinitis such as stuffy, runny, or itchy nose, sneezing, itchy, red, or watery eyes in adults and children above 6 years of age.

Allergic rhinitis may be defined as an inflammatory disease of the nasal mucosa caused due to allergies caused form certain things such as pollen from grass or trees, animals (cats and dogs), house-dust mites, or moulds.

Before using FLORESP NASAL SPRAY tell your doctor if you have severe liver disease, any history of eye conditions such as glaucoma (increase in pressure in the eye) or cataracts (clouding of the lens of the eye), or had nose surgery, or got an infection in your nose.

FLORESP NASAL SPRAY should not be used in pregnant and breastfeeding women, unless advised clearly necessary by the doctor. Contact your doctor before using. FLORESP NASAL SPRAY is not recommended for use in children below 6 years of age. FLORESP NASAL SPRAY should be used with caution in elderly patients. Therefore, contact your doctor before using.

The most common side effects of using FLORESP NASAL SPRAY include nosebleeds (generally minor), nasal ulceration, headache, and shortness of breath. Contact your doctor if any of these worsen or doesn’t improve.

name: Breath EX Capsule 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About BREATH EX CAPSULE

BREATH EX CAPSULE is a combination of Camphor, Chlorothymol, Eucalyptus Oil, Menthol, and Terpineol which belongs to the group of medicines called Antitussives, Antimicrobials, Expectorants, Nasal Decongestants, and Antibacterial agents respectively. It is used to relieve the blockage in the nasal passage and helps in better breathing.

BREATH EX CAPSULE is used to relieve nasal symptoms such as runny nose, itchy nose, stuffy nose, sneezing, and post-nasal drip. also manages cough, common cold, minor pain, and certain bacterial infections.

BREATH EX CAPSULE is also used to reduce skin itching after eczema. Eczema is a condition that occurs due to certain irritants or infectious agents and is characterized by inflammation, itching, cracking, and roughing of the skin.

Before taking this medicine, inform your doctor if you have hepatocellular carcinoma (liver cancer), end-stage kidney disease, or if you are on haemodialysis. BREATH EX CAPSULE is not recommended for use by pregnant, breastfeeding women and in children (aged below 3 years). BREATH EX CAPSULE should be used cautiously in children (below 6 years).

The most common side effects associated with the use of BREATH EX CAPSULE are nasal irritation, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, headache, dizziness, and confusion. Consult your doctor if any of your symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How BREATH EX CAPSULE Works

BREATH EX CAPSULE contains camphor that inhibits cough by acting on certain receptors in the brainstem that controls the cough reflex. It also reduces inflammation by activating certain heat-sensitive receptors, providing relief from pain and inflammation.

Chlorothymol works by inhibiting the growth and multiplication of infection-causing agents such as bacteria and viruses. Eucalyptus Oil works by suppressing the release of inflammation-causing agents. It also inhibits the secretion of mucous, reducing its viscosity, and accelerating the movement of mucus for its clearance.

Menthol works by minimizing nasal congestion. It also provides a cooling effect, minimizing irritation. Terpineol works by killing or stopping the multiplication of bacteria causing infection.

Spray WINCOLD OXY NASAL SPRAY 1-2 times in each nostril up to 3 times daily. Do not use for more than 7 days continuously. It continues to act up to 12 hours and thus provides quick and long-lasting relief from blocked nose.

WINCOLD OXY NASAL SPRAY starts to unblock the nose within 25 seconds. It opens up the nasal passages and allows you to breathe normally. Because it is applied directly inside the nose.

The most common side effects of WINCOLD OXY NASAL SPRAY are nasal dryness and discomfort, sneezing, headache, nausea or dizziness. Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects persists for a longer duration.

warnings.details: There are no well-controlled studies in pregnant women assessing the effects of oxymetazoline. A small study involving 12 healthy pregnant women reported that a single dose of oxymetazoline nasal spray did not affect uterine blood flow. Due to the lack of comprehensive studies, it is advisable to consult a healthcare provider before using oxymetazoline during pregnancy.

There is no available data on whether oxymetazoline passes into human breast milk. Since oxymetazoline is applied topically (nasal spray), systemic absorption is minimal, suggesting a low likelihood of significant transfer into breast milk. Due to the absence of specific data, it is recommended to consult a healthcare provider before using oxymetazoline while breastfeeding.
Do not drive or handle heavy tools or machines if you feel dizziness after using the medicine.
Do not use WINCOLD OXY NASAL SPRAY if you are allergic to Oxymetazoline or any of the other ingredients of this medicine.
WINCOLD OXY NASAL SPRAY should be used with caution if you have high blood pressure, heart disease or diabetes.
WINCOLD OXY NASAL SPRAY is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 12 years of age.

WINCOLD OXY NASAL SPRAY should be used with caution in elderly patients. Elderly individuals, especially those with hypertension, heart disease, glaucoma, or diabetes, should use WINCOLD OXY NASAL SPRAY only after consulting a doctor. Since Oxymetazoline constricts blood vessels.

introduction:
Introduction About MOMEFIT NASAL SPRAY

MOMEFIT NASAL SPRAY contains Mometasone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids. MOMEFIT NASAL SPRAY is used to manage the symptoms of hay fever (seasonal allergic rhinitis) and perennial rhinitis in adults and children aged 2 and older. This medicine is also used to manage nasal polyps in adults aged 18 and over.

Hay Fever is an allergic reaction which occurs due to breathing in pollen from trees, grasses, weeds, molds and fungal spores generally characterized by blocked or runny nose, sneezing and coughing.

Perennial rhinitis is an inflammatory condition which occurs due to sensitivity to a variety of things such as house dust mite, animal hair, feathers and certain foods characterized by symptoms such as blocked nose, sneezing, itching that might occur for an hour or more on most days throughout the year.

Nasal polyps are small growths on the lining of the nose which usually affects both nostrils generally characterized by runny nose, and stuffiness.

Avoid using MOMEFIT NASAL SPRAY, if you are allergic to Mometasone, and or have an unmanageed infection in your nose such as herpes, recent injury or operation on your nose.

Before using MOMEFIT NASAL SPRAY, inform your doctor if you have kidney, or liver disease. MOMEFIT NASAL SPRAY should be used in pregnant women only if it is clearly necessary. It should be used with caution in breastfeeding women.

Your doctor will give the right dose depends on your child’s age, body weight and disease condition. Consult your doctor before using MOMEFIT NASAL SPRAY.

The most common side effects of using MOMEFIT NASAL SPRAY are headache, sneezing, nose bleeds, sore nose or throat, ulcers in the nose and or respiratory tract infection. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms gets worsen.

Introduction About FLOMIST F NASAL SPRAY

FLOMIST F NASAL SPRAY contains Fluticasone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids (glucocorticoids). It is used to manage symptoms of allergic rhinitis such as stuffy, runny, or itchy nose, sneezing, itchy, red, or watery eyes in adults and children above 6 years of age.

Allergic rhinitis may be defined as an inflammatory disease of the nasal mucosa caused due to allergies caused form certain things such as pollen from grass or trees, animals (cats and dogs), house-dust mites, or moulds.

Before using FLOMIST F NASAL SPRAY tell your doctor if you have severe liver disease, any history of eye conditions such as glaucoma (increase in pressure in the eye) or cataracts (clouding of the lens of the eye), or had nose surgery, or got an infection in your nose.

FLOMIST F NASAL SPRAY should not be used in pregnant and breastfeeding women, unless advised clearly necessary by the doctor. Contact your doctor before using. FLOMIST F NASAL SPRAY is not recommended for use in children below 6 years of age. FLOMIST F NASAL SPRAY should be used with caution in elderly patients. Therefore, contact your doctor before using.

The most common side effects of using FLOMIST F NASAL SPRAY include nosebleeds (generally minor), nasal ulceration, headache, and shortness of breath. Contact your doctor if any of these worsen or doesn’t improve.

introduction:
Introduction About ARZEP NASAL SPRAY

ARZEP NASAL SPRAY contains Azelastine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihistamines. It is used to manage allergic rhinitis in adults and in children (aged 6 years or older).

Allergic rhinitis (also known as hay fever) is an allergic response caused due to sensitivity of an individual against various allergens such as pollens, dust, moulds or flakes of skin from certain animals. It can occur seasonally or year-round (perennial) and is often characterized by inflammation of the inner lining of the nose accompanied by nasal congestion, repeated sneezing, and red, watery, or itchy eyes.

Use ARZEP NASAL SPRAY as directed by your physician. It is for intranasal use only. Your doctor will decide the correct dose, the number of sprays and the duration of therapy for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Before using ARZEP NASAL SPRAY inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before using ARZEP NASAL SPRAY as a precaution.

The most common side effects of using ARZEP NASAL SPRAY are bitter taste, headache, slight burning sensation in the nose, throat irritation and nasal bleeding. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.

How ARZEP NASAL SPRAY Works

ARZEP NASAL SPRAY is an anti-allergic medication. It blocks the release of certain chemical messengers in the nasal tract (such as histamines, prostaglandins, leukotrienes) that cause allergic reaction, inflammation and swelling. As a result, it reduces the onset of allergic symptoms and relieves unpleasant symptoms associated with allergic rhinitis.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose, a number of sprays and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Avoid contact of ARZEP NASAL SPRAY with your eyes, ears or mouth. If contact happens accidentally, rinse it off with water immediately.

introduction:
Introduction About NEZAFLO D 70MD NASAL SPRAY

NEZAFLO D Nasal Spray is a corticosteroid and decongestant combination used for relief from allergic rhinitis symptoms including nasal congestion, sneezing, runny nose, and watery eyes.

This nasal spray Should be administered by the intranasal route only. Consult your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

Patients are advised to consult their doctor before taking this medicine if they have high blood pressure, heart disease including angina, diabetes, thyroid disease, hepatic or renal disorders, narrow angle glaucoma or a male patient with difficulty urinating due to enlarged prostate gland.

It is not recommended for children below 4 years of age. The most commonly reported adverse reactions include sore throat, headache and dry nose. Consult your doctor in case of it persists.
uses: Manages Allergic rhinitis with nasal congestion
usesDetails:
Uses Of NEZAFLO D 70MD NASAL SPRAY
Manages Allergic rhinitis with nasal congestion
mechanismOfAction:
How NEZAFLO D 70MD NASAL SPRAY Works
Fluticasone Propionate in NEZAFLO D works by binding to glucocorticoid receptors in nasal tissues, inhibiting the release of inflammatory mediators such as prostaglandins and leukotrienes that cause swelling, redness, and irritation in allergic rhinitis.
Oxymetazoline is an alpha-adrenergic receptor agonist that causes vasoconstriction (shrinks blood vessels) in the nasal mucosa, reducing blood flow and swelling to relieve nasal congestion quickly.
Together, these offer a combination of long-term anti-inflammatory benefits with fast-acting relief of blocked nasal passages, improving breathing and decreasing allergy symptoms.
usageInstructions: Use the nasal spray exactly as prescribed by your healthcare provider.
Gently blow your nose before use to clear nasal passages.
Shake the bottle gently before each use.
Insert the tip of the spray bottle into one nostril, closing the other nostril gently with a finger.
While inhaling gently through the nostril, press the pump to release the spray.
Repeat the process for the other nostril.
Typically used once or twice daily as directed by your doctor, do not exceed prescribed dosage.
Keep your head upright and avoid spraying directly onto the nasal septum (center cartilage).
Breathe in gently during spray application to ensure the medicine reaches deep inside the nasal passages.
Replace the cap tightly after use to maintain hygiene and medicine integrity.

introduction:
Introduction About NAZOMAC M

NAZOMAC M contains Mometasone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids. NAZOMAC M is used to manage the symptoms of hay fever (seasonal allergic rhinitis) and perennial rhinitis in adults and children aged 2 and older. This medicine is also used to manage nasal polyps in adults aged 18 and over.

Hay Fever is an allergic reaction which occurs due to breathing in pollen from trees, grasses, weeds, molds and fungal spores generally characterized by blocked or runny nose, sneezing and coughing.

Perennial rhinitis is an inflammatory condition which occurs due to sensitivity to a variety of things such as house dust mite, animal hair, feathers and certain foods characterized by symptoms such as blocked nose, sneezing, itching that might occur for an hour or more on most days throughout the year.

Nasal polyps are small growths on the lining of the nose which usually affects both nostrils generally characterized by runny nose, and stuffiness.

Avoid using NAZOMAC M, if you are allergic to Mometasone, and or have an unmanageed infection in your nose such as herpes, recent injury or operation on your nose.

Before using NAZOMAC M, inform your doctor if you have kidney, or liver disease. NAZOMAC M should be used in pregnant women only if it is clearly necessary. It should be used with caution in breastfeeding women.

Your doctor will give the right dose depends on your child’s age, body weight and disease condition. Consult your doctor before using NAZOMAC M.

The most common side effects of using NAZOMAC M are headache, sneezing, nose bleeds, sore nose or throat, ulcers in the nose and or respiratory tract infection. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms gets worsen.

name: Zolmist Nasal Spray 0.7ml
introduction:
Introduction About ZOLMIST NASAL SPRAY

ZOLMIST NASAL SPRAY contains Zolmitriptan which belongs to the group of medicines known as Anti-migraine agents. It is indicated to manage acute migraine headache and other associated symptoms of a migraine attack.

Migraine headache is caused by widening of the blood vessels in the head. Always use this ZOLMIST NASAL SPRAY as advised by your doctor.

Inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart problems. Consult your doctor before using this medicine.

Inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before using this medicine. Consult your doctor for advice.

It is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 12 years of age. The common side effects are vomiting, dizziness, taste change and weakness. Consult your doctor for advice if any of the above side effects worsen or persist for a longer duration.
uses: Used to manage acute migraine headache
usesDetails:
Uses Of ZOLMIST NASAL SPRAY
Used to manage acute migraine headache
mechanismOfAction:
How ZOLMIST NASAL SPRAY Works

ZOLMIST NASAL SPRAY works by narrowing blood vessels around the brain, stopping pain signals from being sent to the brain and blocks the release of certain natural substances that cause pain, nausea and other symptoms of migraine.
usageDetails:
How to use ZOLMIST NASAL SPRAY

Use this ZOLMIST NASAL SPRAY according to the dose and frequency as advised by your doctor. It is for nasal use only. Check the label for directions before use.

name: Nasoclear Mist Nasal Spray 100ml
introduction:
Introduction About NASOCLEAR MIST NASAL SPRAY

Nasoclear Mist Nasal Spray is a lubricating spray used to provide relief from nasal dryness, congestion, irritation, allergies or discomfort. It contains sodium chloride as the active ingredient.

When applied into the nostrils, sodium chloride acts as a lubricant that rinses and moisturises the nasal passages. This helps in reducing nasal dryness, itching, irritation and discomfort. It also helps in dissolving thick crusty mucus, thereby providing relief from nasal congestion.

Use Nasoclear Mist Nasal Spray as directed by your physician. It is for intranasal use only. Insert the spray nozzle inside the affected nostril. Press the pump to release the spray and sniff at the same time. Repeat the same to the other nostril if required. Clean the nozzle after application. Nasoclear Mist Nasal Spray is suitable for use in adults and in children.

introduction:
Introduction About MAXTRA O NASAL SPRAY

MAXTRA O NASAL SPRAY contains Oxymetazoline which belongs to the group of medicines called Nasal decongestants. It is used in adults and in adolescents (aged 12 years or above) to provide relief from nasal congestion, itching and discomfort caused due to common cold, sinusitis (inflammation of the sinuses) or allergic rhinitis (an allergic condition).

Always use MAXTRA O NASAL SPRAY as directed by your physician. It is for intranasal use only. Do not use MAXTRA O NASAL SPRAY for more than 7 days without consulting your doctor.

Before using MAXTRA O NASAL SPRAY inform your doctor if you have diabetes, hypertension, glaucoma, hyperthyroidism, or any heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any other problems in nasal tract apart from nasal congestion such as chronic nasal inflammation with very dry nasal passages (rhinitis sicca or atrophic rhinitis).

Consult your doctor before using MAXTRA O NASAL SPRAY if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of using MAXTRA O NASAL SPRAY are irritation or burning sensation after application and nasal dryness. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Nasal congestion (blocked nose)
Symptoms of Allergic rhinitis (such as nasal itching, discomfort, runny nose)
Sinusitis (inflammation of nasal passages)
usesDetails:
Uses Of MAXTRA O NASAL SPRAY

It is used in adults and in adolescents (aged 12 years or above) to provide relief from:

Nasal congestion (blocked nose)

mechanismOfAction:
How MAXTRA O NASAL SPRAY Works

MAXTRA O NASAL SPRAY opens and clears the nasal passages. It works by narrowing down the blood vessels supplying the nasal passage. This helps swollen blood vessels of the nasal tract to return to its normal size which allows the air to pass through the nostrils more freely. It also reduces the excessive nasal secretions and provides temporary relief from nasal inflammation, swelling and discomfort.
usageDetails:
How to use MAXTRA O NASAL SPRAY

Always use MAXTRA O NASAL SPRAY as directed by your physician. It is for intranasal use only.

For Nasal Drops: Gently instil few drops of this medicine into each nostril. Clean the dropper after application.

For Nasal Spray: Insert the spray nozzle inside the affected nostril. Press the pump to release the spray and sniff at the same time. Repeat the same to the other nostril if required. Clean the nozzle after application.

To avoid possible spread of infection, this pack should only be used by a single person. Do not use MAXTRA O NASAL SPRAY for more than 7 days without consulting your doctor. Discard the unused portion after 28 days of opening it.

introduction:
Introduction About AXUNIL 27.5MCG NASAL SPRAY

AXUNIL 27.5MCG NASAL SPRAY contains Fluticasone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids (glucocorticoids). It is used to manage symptoms of allergic rhinitis such as stuffy, runny, or itchy nose, sneezing, itchy, red, or watery eyes in adults and children above 6 years of age.

Allergic rhinitis may be defined as an inflammatory disease of the nasal mucosa caused due to allergies caused form certain things such as pollen from grass or trees, animals (cats and dogs), house-dust mites, or moulds.

Before using AXUNIL 27.5MCG NASAL SPRAY tell your doctor if you have severe liver disease, any history of eye conditions such as glaucoma (increase in pressure in the eye) or cataracts (clouding of the lens of the eye), or had nose surgery, or got an infection in your nose.

AXUNIL 27.5MCG NASAL SPRAY should not be used in pregnant and breastfeeding women, unless advised clearly necessary by the doctor. Contact your doctor before using. AXUNIL 27.5MCG NASAL SPRAY is not recommended for use in children below 6 years of age. AXUNIL 27.5MCG NASAL SPRAY should be used with caution in elderly patients. Therefore, contact your doctor before using.

The most common side effects of using AXUNIL 27.5MCG NASAL SPRAY include nosebleeds (generally minor), nasal ulceration, headache, and shortness of breath. Contact your doctor if any of these worsen or doesn’t improve.
uses: Manages symptoms of allergic rhinitis such as stuffy, runny, or itchy nose, sneezing, itchy, red, or watery eyes in adults and children above 6 years of age
usesDetails:
Uses Of AXUNIL 27.5MCG NASAL SPRAY
Manages symptoms of allergic rhinitis such as stuffy, runny, or itchy nose, sneezing, itchy, red, or watery eyes in adults and children above 6 years of age
mechanismOfAction:
How AXUNIL 27.5MCG NASAL SPRAY Works

AXUNIL 27.5MCG NASAL SPRAY causes vasoconstriction (constriction of blood vessels) and has anti-inflammatory activity. It directly decreases the cells that cause inflammation such as eosinophils, monocytes, mast cells, macrophages, and dendritic cells. AXUNIL 27.5MCG NASAL SPRAY also decreases mucus gland secretions. Therefore, helps in reducing inflammation and making it easier to breathe.
usageDetails:
How to use AXUNIL 27.5MCG NASAL SPRAY

introduction:
Introduction About NETIWASH NASAL RINSE SACHET

Netiwash Nasal Rinse Sachet is an nasal irrigating solution for nasal rinse. It aids during nasal allergies, dryness, nasal symptoms from cold and flu, post nasal drip and nasal congestion and to clean the nose after any surgery. Netiwash Nasal Rinse Sachet contains Sodium Chloride and Sodium Bicarbonate as active ingredients.

Sodium Chloride and Sodium Bicarbonate helps to provide moisture inside the nose that results in dissolving and softening of mucus. This enhances nasal clearance and makes breathing easier.

Use Netiwash Nasal Rinse Sachet as advised by the doctor. It is for nasal use only. Wash your hands. Fill the clean bottle with designated volume of lukewarm distilled, filtered water. Pour the contents of Netiwash Nasal Rinse Sachet into the bottle and dissolve the mixture by gently shaking the bottle. Tilt your head down and Keep your mouth open, without holding your breathe; place the cap snugly against your nasal passage.

Keep squeezing the bottle gently until the solution starts draining from the opposite nasal passage, use at least 60ml to 120ml solution for proper cleansing. Repeat the procedure for other nasal passage. Avoid using it if you have completely blocked nose, ear infection or blocked ears. If you experience any pressures in the ears or burning sensation in the nasal passages, stop irrigation and consult a doctor.

name: NEZAFLO Nasal Spray 120md
introduction:
Introduction About NEZAFLO NASAL SPRAY

NEZAFLO NASAL SPRAY contains Fluticasone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids (glucocorticoids). It is used to manage symptoms of allergic rhinitis such as stuffy, runny, or itchy nose, sneezing, itchy, red, or watery eyes in adults and children above 6 years of age.

Allergic rhinitis may be defined as an inflammatory disease of the nasal mucosa caused due to allergies caused form certain things such as pollen from grass or trees, animals (cats and dogs), house-dust mites, or moulds.

Before using NEZAFLO NASAL SPRAY tell your doctor if you have severe liver disease, any history of eye conditions such as glaucoma (increase in pressure in the eye) or cataracts (clouding of the lens of the eye), or had nose surgery, or got an infection in your nose.

NEZAFLO NASAL SPRAY should not be used in pregnant and breastfeeding women, unless advised clearly necessary by the doctor. Contact your doctor before using. NEZAFLO NASAL SPRAY is not recommended for use in children below 6 years of age. NEZAFLO NASAL SPRAY should be used with caution in elderly patients. Therefore, contact your doctor before using.

The most common side effects of using NEZAFLO NASAL SPRAY include nosebleeds (generally minor), nasal ulceration, headache, and shortness of breath. Contact your doctor if any of these worsen or doesn’t improve.

How NEZAFLO NASAL SPRAY Works

NEZAFLO NASAL SPRAY causes vasoconstriction (constriction of blood vessels) and has anti-inflammatory activity. It directly decreases the cells that cause inflammation such as eosinophils, monocytes, mast cells, macrophages, and dendritic cells. NEZAFLO NASAL SPRAY also decreases mucus gland secretions. Therefore, helps in reducing inflammation and making it easier to breathe.

name: Mucoris P Paediatric Nasal Drops 10ml
introduction:
Introduction About MUCORIS P PAEDIATRIC NASAL DROPS

MUCORIS P PAEDIATRIC NASAL DROPS is paediatric nasal drop used for symptomatic relief from nasal congestion in children. MUCORIS P PAEDIATRIC NASAL DROPS reduces nasal congestion, excessive nasal secretion and restores normal breathing. It contains a medicine called xylometazoline which works by thinning the mucus present in the nasal tract. 

Always use MUCORIS P PAEDIATRIC NASAL DROPS as directed by your physician.One to two drops in each nostril, one or two times daily or as directed by the physician. It is for intranasal use only. Do not use MUCORIS P PAEDIATRIC NASAL DROPS for more than 7 days without consulting your doctor.

Before using MUCORIS P PAEDIATRIC NASAL DROPS inform your doctor if you have diabetes, hypertension, glaucoma, hyperthyroidism, or any heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any other problems in nasal tract apart from nasal congestion such as chronic nasal inflammation with very dry nasal passages (rhinitis sicca or atrophic rhinitis).

The most common side effects of using MUCORIS P PAEDIATRIC NASAL DROPS are irritation or burning sensation after application and nasal dryness. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Nasal congestion
usesDetails:
Uses Of MUCORIS P PAEDIATRIC NASAL DROPS
Nasal congestion
mechanismOfAction:
How MUCORIS P PAEDIATRIC NASAL DROPS Works

MUCORIS P PAEDIATRIC NASAL DROPS opens and clears the nasal passages. It works by narrowing down the blood vessels supplying the nasal passage. This helps swollen blood vessels of the nasal tract to return to its normal size which allows the air to pass through the nostrils more freely. It also reduces excessive nasal secretions and provides temporary relief from nasal inflammation, swelling and discomfort.
usageDetails:
How to use MUCORIS P PAEDIATRIC NASAL DROPS

Always use MUCORIS P PAEDIATRIC NASAL DROPS as directed by your physician. It is for intranasal use only.

For Nasal Drops: Gently instill few drops of this medicine into each nostril.  One to two drops in each nostril, one or two times daily or as directed by the physician.Clean the dropper after application.

For Nasal Spray: Insert the spray nozzle inside the affected nostril. Press the pump to release the spray and sniff at the same time. Repeat the same to the other nostril if required. Clean the nozzle after application.

To avoid possible spread of infection, this pack should only be used by a single person. Do not use MUCORIS P PAEDIATRIC NASAL DROPS for more than 7 days without consulting your doctor. Discard the unused portion after 28 days of opening it.

XYZAL NASAL SPRAY should not be used in pregnant and breastfeeding women, unless advised clearly necessary by the doctor. Contact your doctor before using. XYZAL NASAL SPRAY is not recommended for use in children below 6 years of age. XYZAL NASAL SPRAY should be used with caution in elderly patients. Therefore, contact your doctor before using.

The most common side effects of using XYZAL NASAL SPRAY include nosebleeds (generally minor), nasal ulceration, headache, and shortness of breath. Contact your doctor if any of these worsen or doesn’t improve.

name: NASOCLEAR ULTRA WASH Nasal Spray 100ml
introduction:
Introduction About NASOCLEAR ULTRA WASH NASAL SPRAY

NASOCLEAR ULTRA WASH Nasal Spray is a nasal decongestant used for nasal irrigation and temporarily relieves symptoms associated with sinusitis, cold, flu or allergies such as sneezing, nasal stuffiness, runny nose, post nasal drip. It removes inhaled irritants (dust, pollen) and helps to loosen thick mucus and moistens nasal passages. It contains sodium bicarbonate and sodium chloride as active ingredients.

Sodium bicarbonate or sodium chloride helps to add moisture inside the nose to dissolve and soften thick or crusty mucus. This helps relieve nasal stuffiness and makes breathing easier.

Use NASOCLEAR ULTRA WASH Nasal Spray exactly as advised by your doctor. It is for intranasal use only. Before first use expel short stream of mist into air. Insert tip of nozzle into one nostril and press down on the base of the nozzle so that a gentle mist coats on nasal passage. Gently blow your nose to clear mucus out. Repeat for the other nostril. To flush and irrigate nose, tilt your head to side over the sink. Insert tip of nozzle into the top nostril, squeeze the bottle so that gentle mist fills sinus passage and flows out through opposite nostril. Repeat the same with another nostril.
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of NASOCLEAR ULTRA WASH NASAL SPRAY

NASOCLEAR ULTRA WASH Nasal Spray may cause stinging if the nose is very dry and irritated in some individuals. Consult your doctor if you experience any unusual symptoms while using NASOCLEAR ULTRA WASH Nasal Spray.

introduction:
Introduction About OXYSPRAY SPRAY

OXYSPRAY SPRAY contains Oxymetazoline which belongs to the group of medicines called Nasal decongestants. It is used in adults and in adolescents (aged 12 years or above) to provide relief from nasal congestion, itching and discomfort caused due to common cold, sinusitis (inflammation of the sinuses) or allergic rhinitis (an allergic condition).

Always use OXYSPRAY SPRAY as directed by your physician. It is for intranasal use only. Do not use OXYSPRAY SPRAY for more than 7 days without consulting your doctor.

Before using OXYSPRAY SPRAY inform your doctor if you have diabetes, hypertension, glaucoma, hyperthyroidism, or any heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any other problems in nasal tract apart from nasal congestion such as chronic nasal inflammation with very dry nasal passages (rhinitis sicca or atrophic rhinitis).

Consult your doctor before using OXYSPRAY SPRAY if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of using OXYSPRAY SPRAY are irritation or burning sensation after application and nasal dryness. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

usesDetails:
Uses Of OXYSPRAY SPRAY

It is used in adults and in adolescents (aged 12 years or above) to provide relief from:

Sinusitis (inflammation of nasal passages)
mechanismOfAction:
How OXYSPRAY SPRAY Works

OXYSPRAY SPRAY opens and clears the nasal passages. It works by narrowing down the blood vessels supplying the nasal passage. This helps swollen blood vessels of the nasal tract to return to its normal size which allows the air to pass through the nostrils more freely. It also reduces the excessive nasal secretions and provides temporary relief from nasal inflammation, swelling and discomfort.
usageDetails:
How to use OXYSPRAY SPRAY

Always use OXYSPRAY SPRAY as directed by your physician. It is for intranasal use only.

For Nasal Drops: Gently instil few drops of this medicine into each nostril. Clean the dropper after application.

For Nasal Spray: Insert the spray nozzle inside the affected nostril. Press the pump to release the spray and sniff at the same time. Repeat the same to the other nostril if required. Clean the nozzle after application.

To avoid possible spread of infection, this pack should only be used by a single person. Do not use OXYSPRAY SPRAY for more than 7 days without consulting your doctor. Discard the unused portion after 28 days of opening it.

introduction:
Introduction About INHALADE DROPS

Inhalade is an ideal aid to inhalation. Inhalade is a combination of 7 essential oils for quick relief from symptoms of cold without any side effects. Inhalade is used for common cold, blocked nose & sinusitis. It contains camphor, thymol, menthol, cinnamon oil, terpinol, pine oil and eucalyptus oil as active ingredients that provide relief from congestion caused due to allergies, sinusitis, hay fever and cold.   

Cinnamon oil, terpinol, pine oil and eucalyptus oil aid in relieving blocked nose, thereby easing the symptoms associated with cold. Camphor, thymol, menthol, and terpinol effectively reduce the incidence of allergic reactions.

Inhalade Drops should be used as advised by the doctor. It is only for nasal inhalation. It can be used through steam inhalation or can be applied on to the pillow or handkerchief. It can be used by people of all ages. Inhalade is superior to inhalants available in capsules; quantity can be adjusted as per the condition. Consult a doctor if you experience any allergic reactions while using Inhalade Drops. 

For steam inhalation: Add 2 to 5 drops of Inhalade in half a litre of steaming water and inhale deeply and freely for 10 minutes.
For direct inhalation: Sprinkle 2-3 drops of Inhalade on a handkerchief or paper napkin and inhale deeply and freely. Or add 2-3 drops of Inhalade onto the pillow for inhalation through the night.

name: Metatop Nasal Spray 120Md
introduction:
Introduction About METATOP NASAL SPRAY

METATOP NASAL SPRAY contains Mometasone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids. METATOP NASAL SPRAY is used to manage the symptoms of hay fever (seasonal allergic rhinitis) and perennial rhinitis in adults and children aged 2 and older. This medicine is also used to manage nasal polyps in adults aged 18 and over.

Hay Fever is an allergic reaction which occurs due to breathing in pollen from trees, grasses, weeds, molds and fungal spores generally characterized by blocked or runny nose, sneezing and coughing.

Perennial rhinitis is an inflammatory condition which occurs due to sensitivity to a variety of things such as house dust mite, animal hair, feathers and certain foods characterized by symptoms such as blocked nose, sneezing, itching that might occur for an hour or more on most days throughout the year.

Nasal polyps are small growths on the lining of the nose which usually affects both nostrils generally characterized by runny nose, and stuffiness.

Avoid using METATOP NASAL SPRAY, if you are allergic to Mometasone, and or have an unmanageed infection in your nose such as herpes, recent injury or operation on your nose.

Before using METATOP NASAL SPRAY, inform your doctor if you have kidney, or liver disease. METATOP NASAL SPRAY should be used in pregnant women only if it is clearly necessary. It should be used with caution in breastfeeding women.

Your doctor will give the right dose depends on your child’s age, body weight and disease condition. Consult your doctor before using METATOP NASAL SPRAY.

The most common side effects of using METATOP NASAL SPRAY are headache, sneezing, nose bleeds, sore nose or throat, ulcers in the nose and or respiratory tract infection. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms gets worsen.

In nasal polyps, it relieves the blocked feeling in the nose by reducing the inflammation in the nose thereby enabling easy breathing through the nose.

introduction:
Introduction About SINAREST NEW NASAL SPRAY

SINAREST NEW NASAL SPRAY contains Oxymetazoline which belongs to the group of medicines called Nasal decongestants. It is used in adults and in adolescents (aged 12 years or above) to provide relief from nasal congestion, itching and discomfort caused due to common cold, sinusitis (inflammation of the sinuses) or allergic rhinitis (an allergic condition).

Always use SINAREST NEW NASAL SPRAY as directed by your physician. It is for intranasal use only. Do not use SINAREST NEW NASAL SPRAY for more than 7 days without consulting your doctor.

Before using SINAREST NEW NASAL SPRAY inform your doctor if you have diabetes, hypertension, glaucoma, hyperthyroidism, or any heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any other problems in nasal tract apart from nasal congestion such as chronic nasal inflammation with very dry nasal passages (rhinitis sicca or atrophic rhinitis).

Consult your doctor before using SINAREST NEW NASAL SPRAY if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of using SINAREST NEW NASAL SPRAY are irritation or burning sensation after application and nasal dryness. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Nasal congestion (blocked nose)
Symptoms of Allergic rhinitis (such as nasal itching, discomfort, runny nose)

mechanismOfAction:
How SINAREST NEW NASAL SPRAY Works

SINAREST NEW NASAL SPRAY opens and clears the nasal passages. It works by narrowing down the blood vessels supplying the nasal passage. This helps swollen blood vessels of the nasal tract to return to its normal size which allows the air to pass through the nostrils more freely. It also reduces the excessive nasal secretions and provides temporary relief from nasal inflammation, swelling and discomfort.
usageDetails:
How to use SINAREST NEW NASAL SPRAY

Always use SINAREST NEW NASAL SPRAY as directed by your physician. It is for intranasal use only.

For Nasal Drops: Gently instil few drops of this medicine into each nostril. Clean the dropper after application.

For Nasal Spray: Insert the spray nozzle inside the affected nostril. Press the pump to release the spray and sniff at the same time. Repeat the same to the other nostril if required. Clean the nozzle after application.

To avoid possible spread of infection, this pack should only be used by a single person. Do not use SINAREST NEW NASAL SPRAY for more than 7 days without consulting your doctor. Discard the unused portion after 28 days of opening it.

introduction:
Introduction About FLUBLOCK NASAL SPRAY

FLUBLOCK NASAL SPRAY contains Fluticasone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids (glucocorticoids). It is used to manage symptoms of allergic rhinitis such as stuffy, runny, or itchy nose, sneezing, itchy, red, or watery eyes in adults and children above 6 years of age.

Allergic rhinitis may be defined as an inflammatory disease of the nasal mucosa caused due to allergies caused form certain things such as pollen from grass or trees, animals (cats and dogs), house-dust mites, or moulds.

Before using FLUBLOCK NASAL SPRAY tell your doctor if you have severe liver disease, any history of eye conditions such as glaucoma (increase in pressure in the eye) or cataracts (clouding of the lens of the eye), or had nose surgery, or got an infection in your nose.

FLUBLOCK NASAL SPRAY should not be used in pregnant and breastfeeding women, unless advised clearly necessary by the doctor. Contact your doctor before using. FLUBLOCK NASAL SPRAY is not recommended for use in children below 6 years of age. FLUBLOCK NASAL SPRAY should be used with caution in elderly patients. Therefore, contact your doctor before using.

The most common side effects of using FLUBLOCK NASAL SPRAY include nosebleeds (generally minor), nasal ulceration, headache, and shortness of breath. Contact your doctor if any of these worsen or doesn’t improve.

mechanismOfAction:
How FLUBLOCK NASAL SPRAY Works

FLUBLOCK NASAL SPRAY causes vasoconstriction (constriction of blood vessels) and has anti-inflammatory activity. It directly decreases the cells that cause inflammation such as eosinophils, monocytes, mast cells, macrophages, and dendritic cells. FLUBLOCK NASAL SPRAY also decreases mucus gland secretions. Therefore, helps in reducing inflammation and making it easier to breathe.
usageDetails:
How to use FLUBLOCK NASAL SPRAY

Use FLUBLOCK NASAL SPRAY as advised by your physician. It is for intranasal use only. Shake the bottle before every use. Your doctor will decide what quantity of dose you require at what frequency depending on the severity of the disease and your physical characteristics. Do not start or stop the medicine without consulting your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About ENTOMED PLUS CAPSULE

ENTOMED PLUS CAPSULE is a combination of Camphor, Chlorothymol, Eucalyptus Oil, Menthol, and Terpineol which belongs to the group of medicines called Antitussives, Antimicrobials, Expectorants, Nasal Decongestants, and Antibacterial agents respectively. It is used to relieve the blockage in the nasal passage and helps in better breathing.

ENTOMED PLUS CAPSULE is used to relieve nasal symptoms such as runny nose, itchy nose, stuffy nose, sneezing, and post-nasal drip. also manages cough, common cold, minor pain, and certain bacterial infections.

ENTOMED PLUS CAPSULE is also used to reduce skin itching after eczema. Eczema is a condition that occurs due to certain irritants or infectious agents and is characterized by inflammation, itching, cracking, and roughing of the skin.

Before taking this medicine, inform your doctor if you have hepatocellular carcinoma (liver cancer), end-stage kidney disease, or if you are on haemodialysis. ENTOMED PLUS CAPSULE is not recommended for use by pregnant, breastfeeding women and in children (aged below 3 years). ENTOMED PLUS CAPSULE should be used cautiously in children (below 6 years).

The most common side effects associated with the use of ENTOMED PLUS CAPSULE are nasal irritation, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, headache, dizziness, and confusion. Consult your doctor if any of your symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How ENTOMED PLUS CAPSULE Works

ENTOMED PLUS CAPSULE contains camphor that inhibits cough by acting on certain receptors in the brainstem that controls the cough reflex. It also reduces inflammation by activating certain heat-sensitive receptors, providing relief from pain and inflammation.

Chlorothymol works by inhibiting the growth and multiplication of infection-causing agents such as bacteria and viruses. Eucalyptus Oil works by suppressing the release of inflammation-causing agents. It also inhibits the secretion of mucous, reducing its viscosity, and accelerating the movement of mucus for its clearance.

Menthol works by minimizing nasal congestion. It also provides a cooling effect, minimizing irritation. Terpineol works by killing or stopping the multiplication of bacteria causing infection.
usageDetails:
How to use ENTOMED PLUS CAPSULE

Take ENTOMED PLUS CAPSULE as advised by your physician. It is for inhalational use only. Cut and open this medicine and pour the contents in hot water or on paper to take steam or smell. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Introduction About RESPIZEN 50MCG NASAL SPRAY

RESPIZEN 50MCG NASAL SPRAY contains Mometasone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids. RESPIZEN 50MCG NASAL SPRAY is used to manage the symptoms of hay fever (seasonal allergic rhinitis) and perennial rhinitis in adults and children aged 2 and older. This medicine is also used to manage nasal polyps in adults aged 18 and over.

Hay Fever is an allergic reaction which occurs due to breathing in pollen from trees, grasses, weeds, molds and fungal spores generally characterized by blocked or runny nose, sneezing and coughing.

Perennial rhinitis is an inflammatory condition which occurs due to sensitivity to a variety of things such as house dust mite, animal hair, feathers and certain foods characterized by symptoms such as blocked nose, sneezing, itching that might occur for an hour or more on most days throughout the year.

Nasal polyps are small growths on the lining of the nose which usually affects both nostrils generally characterized by runny nose, and stuffiness.

Avoid using RESPIZEN 50MCG NASAL SPRAY, if you are allergic to Mometasone, and or have an unmanageed infection in your nose such as herpes, recent injury or operation on your nose.

Before using RESPIZEN 50MCG NASAL SPRAY, inform your doctor if you have kidney, or liver disease. RESPIZEN 50MCG NASAL SPRAY should be used in pregnant women only if it is clearly necessary. It should be used with caution in breastfeeding women.

Your doctor will give the right dose depends on your child’s age, body weight and disease condition. Consult your doctor before using RESPIZEN 50MCG NASAL SPRAY.

The most common side effects of using RESPIZEN 50MCG NASAL SPRAY are headache, sneezing, nose bleeds, sore nose or throat, ulcers in the nose and or respiratory tract infection. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms gets worsen.

RESPIZEN 50MCG NASAL SPRAY works by reducing the swelling and irritation in the nose thereby providing relief from sneezing, itching, or a blocked-up or runny nose due to hay fever or perennial rhinitis. In nasal polyps, it relieves the blocked feeling in the nose by reducing the inflammation in the nose thereby enabling easy breathing through the nose.

introduction:
Introduction About ORINASE PAEDIATRIC NASAL SPRAY

ORINASE PAEDIATRIC NASAL SPRAY contains Xylometazoline which belongs to the group of medicines called Nasal decongestants. It is used in children (aged between 1-11 years) to provide relief from nasal congestion caused due to common cold, sinusitis (inflammation of the sinuses) or allergic rhinitis (an allergic condition).

Always use ORINASE PAEDIATRIC NASAL SPRAY as directed by your physician. It is for intranasal use only. Do not use ORINASE PAEDIATRIC NASAL SPRAY for more than 10 days to your child without consulting your doctor.

Before using ORINASE PAEDIATRIC NASAL SPRAY inform your doctor if your child has heart problems or thyroid problems. You must also inform your doctor if your child has any other problems in the nasal tract apart from nasal congestion such as nasal inflammation, nasal dryness or any recent surgery in the nose.

ORINASE PAEDIATRIC NASAL SPRAY should not be used in adults unless recommended by a doctor. The most common side effects of using ORINASE PAEDIATRIC NASAL SPRAY are irritation or burning sensation after application and nasal dryness. Consult your doctor if they bother your child.
uses: Nasal congestion (blocked nose)
usesDetails:
Uses Of ORINASE PAEDIATRIC NASAL SPRAY

It is used in children (aged between 1-11 years) to provide relief from:

Nasal congestion (blocked nose)
mechanismOfAction:
How ORINASE PAEDIATRIC NASAL SPRAY Works

ORINASE PAEDIATRIC NASAL SPRAY opens and clears the nasal passages. It works by narrowing down the blood vessels supplying the nasal passage. This helps swollen blood vessels of the nasal tract to return to its normal size which allows the air to pass through the nostrils more freely. It also reduces excessive nasal secretions and provides temporary relief from nasal inflammation, swelling and discomfort.
usageDetails:
How to use ORINASE PAEDIATRIC NASAL SPRAY

Always use ORINASE PAEDIATRIC NASAL SPRAY as directed by your physician. It is for intranasal use only.

For Nasal Drops: Gently instill few drops of this medicine into each nostril. Clean the dropper after application.

For Nasal Spray: Insert the spray nozzle inside the affected nostril. Press the pump to release the spray and sniff at the same time. Repeat the same to the other nostril if required. Clean the nozzle after application.

To avoid possible spread of infection, this pack should only be used by a single person. Do not use ORINASE PAEDIATRIC NASAL SPRAY for more than 10 days without consulting your doctor. Discard the unused portion after 28 days of opening it.

ORINASE PAEDIATRIC NASAL SPRAY is intended for use only in the children. Therefore, it should not be used in adults unless recommended by a doctor.
ORINASE PAEDIATRIC NASAL SPRAY does not affect your child’s ability to drive or operate any heavy tools.
Do not use ORINASE PAEDIATRIC NASAL SPRAY if your child is allergic to Xylometazoline or to any other ingredients of this medicine.
ORINASE PAEDIATRIC NASAL SPRAY should be used with caution in children with heart disease (such as hypertension, prolonged QT syndrome). Therefore, consult your doctor before administration.

Others

ORINASE PAEDIATRIC NASAL SPRAY is not recommended for use if your child:

Has any inflammation in the nasal passages
Recently had a neurosurgery or surgery in their nose
Has closed angle glaucoma (increased pressure within the eyes)
Has chronic nasal inflammation and nasal dryness (such as rhinitis sicca or atrophic rhinitis)
Has phaeochromocytoma (a rare tumor of the adrenal glands)

Before using ORINASE PAEDIATRIC NASAL SPRAY inform your doctor if your child has:

Diabetes
Hyperthyroidism (overactive thyroid gland)
An enlarged prostate gland

Use in pediatrics:

ORINASE PAEDIATRIC NASAL SPRAY can be used in children and adolescents aged between 1-11 years. It is not recommended for use in infants aged below 1 year. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice before administration.

Use in geriatrics:

ORINASE PAEDIATRIC NASAL SPRAY is intended for use only in the children. Therefore, it should not be used in adults unless recommended by a doctor.

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before using ORINASE PAEDIATRIC NASAL SPRAY, inform your doctor if your child is taking any of the following medicines:

Antidepressants (used to manage depression) such as monoamine oxidase inhibitors (Ex. moclobemide, isocarboxazid, phenelzine and tranylcypromine), tricyclic antidepressants (Ex. amitriptyline, nortriptyline), lithium, fluoxetine, sertraline, citalopram, escitalopram etc
Medicines used to control blood pressure such as alpha blockers (Ex. prazosin, terazocin) or beta blockers (Ex. propranolol, atenolol)
Timolol, betaxolol (used to manage glaucoma in the eye)
Appetite suppressants (used for suppressing hunger) Ex. phentermine
Oxytocin (a medicine used during childbirth)
Ergot alkaloids (used for migraine headache) Ex. ergotamine

Overdosage:

If your child accidentally swallowed the medicine or applied too much of ORINASE PAEDIATRIC NASAL SPRAY, consult your doctor immediately. Symptoms of overdosage might include severe dizziness, increased sweating, severely lowered body temperature, headache, slow heart rate, hypertension or difficulty in breathing.

introduction:
Introduction About MUCORIS PEAD NASAL SPRAY

MUCORIS PEAD NASAL SPRAY contains Xylometazoline which belongs to the group of medicines called Nasal decongestants. It is used in children (aged between 1-11 years) to provide relief from nasal congestion caused due to common cold, sinusitis (inflammation of the sinuses) or allergic rhinitis (an allergic condition).

Always use MUCORIS PEAD NASAL SPRAY as directed by your physician. It is for intranasal use only. Do not use MUCORIS PEAD NASAL SPRAY for more than 10 days to your child without consulting your doctor.

Before using MUCORIS PEAD NASAL SPRAY inform your doctor if your child has heart problems or thyroid problems. You must also inform your doctor if your child has any other problems in the nasal tract apart from nasal congestion such as nasal inflammation, nasal dryness or any recent surgery in the nose.

MUCORIS PEAD NASAL SPRAY should not be used in adults unless recommended by a doctor. The most common side effects of using MUCORIS PEAD NASAL SPRAY are irritation or burning sensation after application and nasal dryness. Consult your doctor if they bother your child.
uses: Nasal congestion (blocked nose)
usesDetails:
Uses Of MUCORIS PEAD NASAL SPRAY

It is used in children (aged between 1-11 years) to provide relief from:

Nasal congestion (blocked nose)
mechanismOfAction:
How MUCORIS PEAD NASAL SPRAY Works

MUCORIS PEAD NASAL SPRAY opens and clears the nasal passages. It works by narrowing down the blood vessels supplying the nasal passage. This helps swollen blood vessels of the nasal tract to return to its normal size which allows the air to pass through the nostrils more freely. It also reduces excessive nasal secretions and provides temporary relief from nasal inflammation, swelling and discomfort.
usageDetails:
How to use MUCORIS PEAD NASAL SPRAY

Always use MUCORIS PEAD NASAL SPRAY as directed by your physician. It is for intranasal use only.

For Nasal Drops: Gently instill few drops of this medicine into each nostril. Clean the dropper after application.

For Nasal Spray: Insert the spray nozzle inside the affected nostril. Press the pump to release the spray and sniff at the same time. Repeat the same to the other nostril if required. Clean the nozzle after application.

To avoid possible spread of infection, this pack should only be used by a single person. Do not use MUCORIS PEAD NASAL SPRAY for more than 10 days without consulting your doctor. Discard the unused portion after 28 days of opening it.

Has any inflammation in the nasal passages
Recently had a neurosurgery or surgery in their nose
Has closed angle glaucoma (increased pressure within the eyes)

Has phaeochromocytoma (a rare tumor of the adrenal glands)

Before using MUCORIS PEAD NASAL SPRAY inform your doctor if your child has:

Diabetes
Hyperthyroidism (overactive thyroid gland)
An enlarged prostate gland

MUCORIS PEAD NASAL SPRAY is intended for use only in the children. Therefore, it should not be used in adults unless recommended by a doctor.

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before using MUCORIS PEAD NASAL SPRAY, inform your doctor if your child is taking any of the following medicines:

Antidepressants (used to manage depression) such as monoamine oxidase inhibitors (Ex. moclobemide, isocarboxazid, phenelzine and tranylcypromine), tricyclic antidepressants (Ex. amitriptyline, nortriptyline), lithium, fluoxetine, sertraline, citalopram, escitalopram etc
Medicines used to control blood pressure such as alpha blockers (Ex. prazosin, terazocin) or beta blockers (Ex. propranolol, atenolol)
Timolol, betaxolol (used to manage glaucoma in the eye)
Appetite suppressants (used for suppressing hunger) Ex. phentermine
Oxytocin (a medicine used during childbirth)
Ergot alkaloids (used for migraine headache) Ex. ergotamine

Overdosage:

If your child accidentally swallowed the medicine or applied too much of MUCORIS PEAD NASAL SPRAY, consult your doctor immediately. Symptoms of overdosage might include severe dizziness, increased sweating, severely lowered body temperature, headache, slow heart rate, hypertension or difficulty in breathing.

name: Easibreathe Capsule 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About EASIBREATHE CAPSULE

Easibreathe Capsule is a decongestant used to relieve stuffy, irritated nose and heaviness in head due to cold. It contains camphor, chlorothymol, eucalyptol, menthol, and terpineol as active ingredients that work by clearing blockages in the nose.

Menthol is mainly used to relieve symptoms of bronchitis, sinusitis and similar conditions. Eucalyptol kills bacteria and eases breathing difficulties in people with croup (upper airway infection causing barking cough), asthma and bronchitis.

Terpineol exerts anti-infective effects. Chlorothymol is a phenolic antiseptic that has a special use in symptomatic relief from common cold. Camphor acts as a rubefacient and mild pain killer.

Use Easibreathe Capsule as advised by your physician. It is for inhalational use only. Avoid direct contact with eyes and nostrils. Do not ingest. It should not be used in neonates and patients with renal calculi. Ask your doctor before using it during pregnancy and breastfeeding.
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of EASIBREATHE CAPSULE

Easibreathe Capsule may cause tingling sensations, ataxia (loss of control of bodily movements), burning, abdominal pain, vomiting and nausea in some individuals. Consult your doctor if you experience any such side effects while using it.

SINAREST S 0.74% NASAL DROPS contains Sodium chloride which belongs to the group of medicines called Electrolytes. It is used to manage dry, blocked, crusty and itchy nose. It can also be used to manage stuffy nose in babies and children and helps their breathing easier.

It is safe to be used in children and elderly people. Consult your doctor before using it. Do not operate any machines or engage in any activities which requires mental alertness and coordination while using this medicine.

introduction:
Introduction About SINAREST NASAL SPRAY

SINAREST NASAL SPRAY is a combination of Oxymetazoline and Sorbitol which belongs to the group of medicines called Nasal decongestants and Sugar alcohols respectively. It is used to relieve nasal congestion due to cold, upper respiratory allergies, or sinusitis.

Nasal congestion is defined as stuffy nose that occurs when nasal and adjacent tissues and blood vessels become swollen with excess fluid, causing a "stuffy" packed feeling.

During course of the management your doctor might regularly examine your condition to avoid any untoward side effects. Safety and effectiveness of SINAREST NASAL SPRAY in children have not been established.

Before using SINAREST NASAL SPRAY, inform your doctor if you have any heart problems. It has not been studied in pregnancy and breastfeeding, so consult your doctor before using it.

The most common side effects of using SINAREST NASAL SPRAY are local stinging or burning feeling, sneezing, and dryness of the mouth and throat. Contact your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

How SINAREST NASAL SPRAY Works

SINAREST NASAL SPRAY relieves stuffy nose where Oxymetazoline acts on alpha-adrenergic receptors in the vessels of the conjunctiva and nasal mucosa, leading to narrowing of vessels, resulting in decreased conjunctival congestion, decreased blood flow, and decreased nasal congestion, and Sorbitol manages dehydration and improves miniaturization of nasal mucosa.

Introduction About NOSIKIND NASAL SPRAY

NOSIKIND NASAL SPRAY is used for symptomatic relief from nasal congestion caused due to allergies and common cold. It contains a medicine called xylometazoline which works by thinning the mucus present in the nasal tract.

introduction:
Introduction About NASONASE PLUS SACHET

Nasonase Plus Sachet is a nasal decongestants used for nasal irrigation and temporarily relieves symptoms associated with sinusitis, cold, flu or allergies such as sneezing, nasal stuffiness, runny nose, post nasal drip. It removes inhaled irritants (dust, pollen) and helps to loosen thick mucus and moistens nasal passages. It contains sodium bicarbonate and sodium chloride as active ingredients.

Sodium bicarbonate or sodium chloride helps to add moisture inside the nose to dissolve and soften thick or crusty mucus. This helps relieve nasal stuffiness and makes breathing easier.

Use Nasonase Plus Sachet exactly as advised by your doctor. It is for intranasal use only. Cut or open 1 sachet and pour all the contents into Nasonase Plus Squeeze bottle. Pour up to 200 ml of previously boiled lukewarm water into it. Do not use boiling hot water. Close the bottle and shake well until all the components are dissolved. Use half of the solution to wash nasal passages and sinus cavity and let it come through another nostril. Repeat the process for another nostril with the remaining half of the solution.
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of NASONASE PLUS SACHET

Nasonase Plus Sachet may cause stinging if the nose is very dry and irritated in some individuals. Consult your doctor if you experience any unusual symptoms while using Nasonase Plus Sachet.

name: Butrum Nasal Spray 2.5ml
introduction:
Introduction About BUTRUM NASAL SPRAY

BUTRUM NASAL SPRAY contains Butorphanol, which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioid agonist/antagonist analgesics. It is used to manage moderate to severe pain. Pain is an uncomfortable sensation in the body which stems from activation of the nervous system it generally occurs as an annoying or debilitating sensation which can be characterized as a sharp, dull, throbbing, pinching, stinging, and/or burning sensation in affected individuals.

Before taking BUTRUM NASAL SPRAY, inform your doctor if you have a head injury or increased intracranial pressure (increased pressure in the head), respiratory, hepatic, or renal impairment, and/or heart diseases (such as acute myocardial infarction, ventricular dysfunction, or coronary insufficiency).

In pregnant and breastfeeding women, BUTRUM NASAL SPRAY should be used with caution. It is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). It should be used with caution in elderly patients (those over the age of 65). The most common side effects associated with the use of BUTRUM NASAL SPRAY are excessive sleepiness, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, nasal congestion, sleeplessness, and/or lethargy. Consult your doctor if any of your symptoms get worse.
uses: Manage and relieve moderate to severe acute pain
usesDetails:
Uses Of BUTRUM NASAL SPRAY
Manage and relieve moderate to severe acute pain
mechanismOfAction:
How BUTRUM NASAL SPRAY Works

BUTRUM NASAL SPRAY works by blocking certain receptors (responsible for pain) in the brain and spinal cord which leads to blockage of pain transmission thus providing relief from moderate to severe acute pain in affected individuals.
usageDetails:
How to use BUTRUM NASAL SPRAY

Take BUTRUM NASAL SPRAY as advised by your physician. It is for intranasal use only. Blow your nose. Pull the clear cover off the pump unit. Remove the protective clip. Before the initial use, prime the unit by pumping the sprayer until a fine mist appears. Insert the spray tip approximately 1 cm into one nostril, close the other nostril with your forefinger, and pump the spray unit firmly and quickly. Your doctor will determine the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About XYLOSON NASAL DROPS

XYLOSON NASAL DROPS is paediatric nasal drop used for symptomatic relief from nasal congestion in children. XYLOSON NASAL DROPS reduces nasal congestion, excessive nasal secretion and restores normal breathing. It contains a medicine called xylometazoline which works by thinning the mucus present in the nasal tract. 

Always use XYLOSON NASAL DROPS as directed by your physician.One to two drops in each nostril, one or two times daily or as directed by the physician. It is for intranasal use only. Do not use XYLOSON NASAL DROPS for more than 7 days without consulting your doctor.

Before using XYLOSON NASAL DROPS inform your doctor if you have diabetes, hypertension, glaucoma, hyperthyroidism, or any heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any other problems in nasal tract apart from nasal congestion such as chronic nasal inflammation with very dry nasal passages (rhinitis sicca or atrophic rhinitis).

The most common side effects of using XYLOSON NASAL DROPS are irritation or burning sensation after application and nasal dryness. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Nasal congestion

mechanismOfAction:
How XYLOSON NASAL DROPS Works

XYLOSON NASAL DROPS opens and clears the nasal passages. It works by narrowing down the blood vessels supplying the nasal passage. This helps swollen blood vessels of the nasal tract to return to its normal size which allows the air to pass through the nostrils more freely. It also reduces excessive nasal secretions and provides temporary relief from nasal inflammation, swelling and discomfort.

How to use XYLOSON NASAL DROPS

Always use XYLOSON NASAL DROPS as directed by your physician. It is for intranasal use only.

For Nasal Drops: Gently instill few drops of this medicine into each nostril.  One to two drops in each nostril, one or two times daily or as directed by the physician.Clean the dropper after application.

For Nasal Spray: Insert the spray nozzle inside the affected nostril. Press the pump to release the spray and sniff at the same time. Repeat the same to the other nostril if required. Clean the nozzle after application.

To avoid possible spread of infection, this pack should only be used by a single person. Do not use XYLOSON NASAL DROPS for more than 7 days without consulting your doctor. Discard the unused portion after 28 days of opening it.

name: OTRIVIN MOISTURISING ADULT Nasal Drops 10ml
introduction:
Introduction About OTRIVIN MOISTURISING ADULT NASAL DROPS

OTRIVIN MOISTURIZING ADULT Nasal Drops is a type of nasal spray used to manage nasal mucosa dryness and provide rapid relief from nasal congestion/stuffy nose for up to 12 hours in affected individuals. It contains xylometazoline hydrochloride and sorbitol solution as active ingredients which provide relief from a blocked nose by reducing excess nasal secretion.

Xylometazoline hydrochloride is a nasal decongestant which provides relief from a blocked nose by reducing excess nasal secretion and swollen blood vessels in the nose. Sorbitol solution is a moisturizing agent which retains water and reduces dryness in the nose. 

Always use OTRIVIN MOISTURIZING ADULT Nasal Drops as directed by your physician. Clean your nose and tilt your head slightly back to apply the drop in each nostril. Keep the head tilted for short time to allow the drops to spread throughout the nose. Repeat with other nostrils. Clean and dry the nozzle after use. Instil 2-4 drops 2-3 times daily in each nostril for adults and children (aged above 12 years). Do not exceed the recommended dosage. Avoid using this medicine more than 10 days. Prolonged/excessive use cause stuffiness in the nose which may worsen. Avoid administering this medicine in child (aged below 12 years).
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of OTRIVIN MOISTURISING ADULT NASAL DROPS

OTRIVIN MOISTURIZING ADULT Nasal Drops may cause local burning sensation, irritation, dryness of nasal mucosa, nausea, headache, skin rash, blurred vision, irregular/fast heartbeats in some individuals. Consult your doctor if you notice any such side effects while using OTRIVIN MOISTURIZING ADULT Nasal Drops.

It also reduces the excessive nasal secretions and provides temporary relief from nasal inflammation, swelling and discomfort.

Introduction About NASIVION CARE ADULT DROPS

Always use NASIVION CARE ADULT DROPS as directed by your physician. It is for intranasal use only. Do not use NASIVION CARE ADULT DROPS for more than 7 days without consulting your doctor.

Before using NASIVION CARE ADULT DROPS inform your doctor if you have diabetes, hypertension, glaucoma, hyperthyroidism, or any heart problems. Consult your doctor before using NASIVION CARE ADULT DROPS if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of using NASIVION CARE ADULT DROPS are irritation or burning sensation after application and nasal dryness. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

How NASIVION CARE ADULT DROPS Works

It also reduces the excessive nasal secretions and provides temporary relief from nasal inflammation, swelling and discomfort.

Introduction About NASOVID ADULT NASAL SPRAY

NASOVID ADULT NASAL SPRAY is used for symptomatic relief from nasal congestion caused due to allergies and common cold. It contains a medicine called xylometazoline which works by thinning the mucus present in the nasal tract. 

Always use NASOVID ADULT NASAL SPRAY as directed by your physician. Gently instil 1-2 drops in each nostril, one or two times daily or as directed by the physician. It is for intranasal use only. Do not use NASOVID ADULT NASAL SPRAY for more than 7 days without consulting your doctor.

Before using NASOVID ADULT NASAL SPRAY inform your doctor if you have diabetes, hypertension, glaucoma, hyperthyroidism, or any heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any other problems in nasal tract apart from nasal congestion such as chronic nasal inflammation with very dry nasal passages (rhinitis sicca or atrophic rhinitis).

The most common side effects of using NASOVID ADULT NASAL SPRAY are irritation or burning sensation after application and nasal dryness. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

How NASOVID ADULT NASAL SPRAY Works

NASOVID ADULT NASAL SPRAY opens and clears the nasal passages. It works by narrowing down the blood vessels supplying the nasal passage. This helps swollen blood vessels of the nasal tract to return to its normal size which allows the air to pass through the nostrils more freely. It also reduces excessive nasal secretions and provides temporary relief from nasal inflammation, swelling and discomfort.

Always use NASOVID ADULT NASAL SPRAY as directed by your physician. It is for intranasal use only.

To avoid possible spread of infection, this pack should only be used by a single person. Do not use NASOVID ADULT NASAL SPRAY for more than 7 days without consulting your doctor. Discard the unused portion after 28 days of opening it.

introduction:
Introduction About XYLOSON P NASAL DROPS

Xyloson P Nasal Drops is used for nasal congestion in children. It is used in the short-term symptomatic management of nasal congestion caused due to common cold, acute sinusitis, rhinitis, nasopharyngitis, acute middle ear infection. It contains Xylometazoline as active ingredient which loosens the nasal secretions thereby moisturizes the nasal cavity.

Xylometazoline works by opening the nasal passages. It cleanses the nasal cavities by reducing excessive nasal secretions and returns the swollen blood vessels to normal size. Thus, it relives a blocked nose and helps for normal breathing. It also has a water retention ability which helps to manage drying and irritation of nasal mucosa and provides further moisturization.

Always use Xyloson P Nasal Drops as directed by the physician. It is for external use only. Avoid contact with eyes. It is for intranasal use only.  Gently instil few drops of this medicine into each nostril. Clean the dropper after each application. Do not exceed more than 3 applications into each nostril and the last application should be preferably done during the bedtime. Do not administer if your child is allergic to any of its ingredients.

Always use Karvol Clear Saline Nasal Spray as directed by your physician. It is for intranasal use only. It can be used as often as needed. It can be safely used for all ages.

introduction:
Introduction About NASOCOBAL 250MCG NASAL SPRAY

NASOCOBAL 250MCG NASAL SPRAY contains Mecobalamin which belongs to the group of medicines called Vitamins. NASOCOBAL 250MCG NASAL SPRAY is used as a maintenance therapy in adult patients with pernicious anaemia who are in remission status (following intramuscular vitamin B12 therapy) without the involvement of nervous system.

NASOCOBAL 250MCG NASAL SPRAY is also used to manage adult patients with vitamin B12 deficiency that occurred due to dietary, drug-induced, and/or malabsorption factors. It is also indicated for use to manage vitamin B12 deficiency in adult patients with vitamin B12 requirements.

NASOCOBAL 250MCG NASAL SPRAY is not recommended for use in patients allergic to mecobalamin, cobalt, and/or vitamin B12. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from severe Leber hereditary optic neuropathy (inherited form of vision loss), and/or runny nose/nasal blockage.

Before using NASOCOBAL 250MCG NASAL SPRAY, inform your doctor if you have early Leber’s disease, low levels of folate/iron in your blood (associated with signs such as extreme tiredness, sore/red tongue, muscle weakness), kidney problems (such as chronic renal disease), and/or liver problems.

NASOCOBAL 250MCG NASAL SPRAY should be used with caution during pregnancy only if it is clearly necessary. It is also used with caution in breastfeeding women and children & adolescents (aged below 18 years).  The medicine is also advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of using NASOCOBAL 250MCG NASAL SPRAY are headache, weakness, inflamed/swollen tongue, burning/prickling sensation in arms/legs, nausea, and/or stuffy nose. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

usageDetails:
How to use NASOCOBAL 250MCG NASAL SPRAY

Use NASOCOBAL 250MCG NASAL SPRAY as advised by your physician. It is for intranasal use only. Gently, blow your nose to clear both nostrils. Hold NASOCOBAL 250MCG NASAL SPRAY with your thumb on the bottom with your index & middle finger on either side of the nozzle and gently close one side of your nostril with your other index finger. Insert the nozzle into the open nostril about half an inch or as far as it feels comfortable and tilt your head slightly forward while nozzle insertion. Breathe in gently (from your nostril) and close your mouth. Press the plunger firmly upwards with your thumb and remove the nozzle. Keep your head firm for 10 to 20 seconds while gently breathing in through your nose and breathing out through your mouth. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About SNEZEEBREATH INHALATION CAPSULE

SNEZEEBREATH INHALATION CAPSULE is a combination of Camphor, Chlorothymol, Eucalyptus Oil, Menthol, and Terpineol which belongs to the group of medicines called Antitussives, Antimicrobials, Expectorants, Nasal Decongestants, and Antibacterial agents respectively. It is used to relieve the blockage in the nasal passage and helps in better breathing.

SNEZEEBREATH INHALATION CAPSULE is used to relieve nasal symptoms such as runny nose, itchy nose, stuffy nose, sneezing, and post-nasal drip. also manages cough, common cold, minor pain, and certain bacterial infections.

SNEZEEBREATH INHALATION CAPSULE is also used to reduce skin itching after eczema. Eczema is a condition that occurs due to certain irritants or infectious agents and is characterized by inflammation, itching, cracking, and roughing of the skin.

Before taking this medicine, inform your doctor if you have hepatocellular carcinoma (liver cancer), end-stage kidney disease, or if you are on haemodialysis. SNEZEEBREATH INHALATION CAPSULE is not recommended for use by pregnant, breastfeeding women and in children (aged below 3 years). SNEZEEBREATH INHALATION CAPSULE should be used cautiously in children (below 6 years).

The most common side effects associated with the use of SNEZEEBREATH INHALATION CAPSULE are nasal irritation, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, headache, dizziness, and confusion. Consult your doctor if any of your symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About NOSYCLEAR ADULT NASAL SPRAY

NOSYCLEAR ADULT NASAL SPRAY is used for symptomatic relief from nasal congestion caused due to allergies and common cold. It contains a medicine called xylometazoline which works by thinning the mucus present in the nasal tract. 

Always use NOSYCLEAR ADULT NASAL SPRAY as directed by your physician. Gently instil 1-2 drops in each nostril, one or two times daily or as directed by the physician. It is for intranasal use only. Do not use NOSYCLEAR ADULT NASAL SPRAY for more than 7 days without consulting your doctor.

Before using NOSYCLEAR ADULT NASAL SPRAY inform your doctor if you have diabetes, hypertension, glaucoma, hyperthyroidism, or any heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any other problems in nasal tract apart from nasal congestion such as chronic nasal inflammation with very dry nasal passages (rhinitis sicca or atrophic rhinitis).

The most common side effects of using NOSYCLEAR ADULT NASAL SPRAY are irritation or burning sensation after application and nasal dryness. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
