usesDetails:
Uses Of NOSYCLEAR ADULT NASAL SPRAY
Nasal congestion
mechanismOfAction:
How NOSYCLEAR ADULT NASAL SPRAY Works

NOSYCLEAR ADULT NASAL SPRAY opens and clears the nasal passages. It works by narrowing down the blood vessels supplying the nasal passage. This helps swollen blood vessels of the nasal tract to return to its normal size which allows the air to pass through the nostrils more freely. It also reduces excessive nasal secretions and provides temporary relief from nasal inflammation, swelling and discomfort.
usageDetails:
How to use NOSYCLEAR ADULT NASAL SPRAY

Always use NOSYCLEAR ADULT NASAL SPRAY as directed by your physician. It is for intranasal use only.

For Nasal Drops: Gently instil few drops of this medicine into each nostril.  One to two drops in each nostril, one or two times daily or as directed by the physician. Clean the dropper after application.

For Nasal Spray: Insert the spray nozzle inside the affected nostril. Press the pump to release the spray and sniff at the same time. Repeat the same to the other nostril if required. Clean the nozzle after application.

To avoid possible spread of infection, this pack should only be used by a single person. Do not use NOSYCLEAR ADULT NASAL SPRAY for more than 7 days without consulting your doctor. Discard the unused portion after 28 days of opening it.

NOSYCLEAR ADULT NASAL SPRAY can be used in children and adolescents aged 12 years or above. introduction:
Introduction About HATRIC VAPO CAPSULE

HATRIC VAPO CAPSULE is a combination of Camphor, Chlorothymol, Eucalyptus Oil, Menthol, and Terpineol which belongs to the group of medicines called Antitussives, Antimicrobials, Expectorants, Nasal Decongestants, and Antibacterial agents respectively. It is used to relieve the blockage in the nasal passage and helps in better breathing.

HATRIC VAPO CAPSULE is used to relieve nasal symptoms such as runny nose, itchy nose, stuffy nose, sneezing, and post-nasal drip. also manages cough, common cold, minor pain, and certain bacterial infections.

HATRIC VAPO CAPSULE is also used to reduce skin itching after eczema. Eczema is a condition that occurs due to certain irritants or infectious agents and is characterized by inflammation, itching, cracking, and roughing of the skin.

Before taking this medicine, inform your doctor if you have hepatocellular carcinoma (liver cancer), end-stage kidney disease, or if you are on haemodialysis. HATRIC VAPO CAPSULE is not recommended for use by pregnant, breastfeeding women and in children (aged below 3 years). HATRIC VAPO CAPSULE should be used cautiously in children (below 6 years).

The most common side effects associated with the use of HATRIC VAPO CAPSULE are nasal irritation, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, headache, dizziness, and confusion. Consult your doctor if any of your symptoms worsen.

warnings.details: There are no well-controlled studies in pregnant women assessing the effects of oxymetazoline. A small study involving 12 healthy pregnant women reported that a single dose of oxymetazoline nasal spray did not affect uterine blood flow. Due to the lack of comprehensive studies, it is advisable to consult a healthcare provider before using oxymetazoline during pregnancy.

There is no available data on whether oxymetazoline passes into human breast milk. Since oxymetazoline is applied topically (nasal spray), systemic absorption is minimal, suggesting a low likelihood of significant transfer into breast milk. Due to the absence of specific data, it is recommended to consult a healthcare provider before using oxymetazoline while breastfeeding.
Do not drive or handle heavy tools or machines if you feel dizziness after using the medicine.
Do not use NOSTRIOL NASAL SPRAY if you are allergic to Oxymetazoline or any of the other ingredients of this medicine.
NOSTRIOL NASAL SPRAY should be used with caution if you have high blood pressure, heart disease or diabetes.
NOSTRIOL NASAL SPRAY is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 12 years of age.

NOSTRIOL NASAL SPRAY should be used with caution in elderly patients. Elderly individuals, especially those with hypertension, heart disease, glaucoma, or diabetes, should use NOSTRIOL NASAL SPRAY only after consulting a doctor. Since Oxymetazoline constricts blood vessels.

There are no well-controlled studies in pregnant women assessing the effects of oxymetazoline. A small study involving 12 healthy pregnant women reported that a single dose of oxymetazoline nasal spray did not affect uterine blood flow. Due to the lack of comprehensive studies, it is advisable to consult a healthcare provider before using oxymetazoline during pregnancy.

Breastfeeding
CONSULT YOUR DOCTOR

There is no available data on whether oxymetazoline passes into human breast milk. Since oxymetazoline is applied topically (nasal spray), systemic absorption is minimal, suggesting a low likelihood of significant transfer into breast milk. Due to the absence of specific data, it is recommended to consult a healthcare provider before using oxymetazoline while breastfeeding.

Driving and Using Machines
USE WITH CAUTION

Do not drive or handle heavy tools or machines if you feel dizziness after using the medicine.

Allergy
CONTRAINDICATED

Do not use NOSTRIOL NASAL SPRAY if you are allergic to Oxymetazoline or any of the other ingredients of this medicine.

Heart Disease
USE WITH CAUTION

NOSTRIOL NASAL SPRAY should be used with caution if you have high blood pressure, heart disease or diabetes.

Use In Pediatrics
CONSULT YOUR DOCTOR

NOSTRIOL NASAL SPRAY is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 12 years of age.

Use In Geriatrics
USE WITH CAUTION

NOSTRIOL NASAL SPRAY should be used with caution in elderly patients. Elderly individuals, especially those with hypertension, heart disease, glaucoma, or diabetes, should use NOSTRIOL NASAL SPRAY only after consulting a doctor. Since Oxymetazoline constricts blood vessels.

introduction:
Introduction About NASOLIFE PD NASAL DROPS

NASOLIFE PD NASAL DROPS is paediatric nasal drop used for symptomatic relief from nasal congestion in children. NASOLIFE PD NASAL DROPS reduces nasal congestion, excessive nasal secretion and restores normal breathing. It contains a medicine called xylometazoline which works by thinning the mucus present in the nasal tract. 

Always use NASOLIFE PD NASAL DROPS as directed by your physician.One to two drops in each nostril, one or two times daily or as directed by the physician. It is for intranasal use only. Do not use NASOLIFE PD NASAL DROPS for more than 7 days without consulting your doctor.

Before using NASOLIFE PD NASAL DROPS inform your doctor if you have diabetes, hypertension, glaucoma, hyperthyroidism, or any heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any other problems in nasal tract apart from nasal congestion such as chronic nasal inflammation with very dry nasal passages (rhinitis sicca or atrophic rhinitis).

The most common side effects of using NASOLIFE PD NASAL DROPS are irritation or burning sensation after application and nasal dryness. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Nasal congestion
usesDetails:
Uses Of NASOLIFE PD NASAL DROPS
Nasal congestion
mechanismOfAction:
How NASOLIFE PD NASAL DROPS Works

NASOLIFE PD NASAL DROPS opens and clears the nasal passages. It works by narrowing down the blood vessels supplying the nasal passage. This helps swollen blood vessels of the nasal tract to return to its normal size which allows the air to pass through the nostrils more freely. It also reduces excessive nasal secretions and provides temporary relief from nasal inflammation, swelling and discomfort.
usageDetails:
How to use NASOLIFE PD NASAL DROPS

Always use NASOLIFE PD NASAL DROPS as directed by your physician. It is for intranasal use only.

For Nasal Drops: Gently instill few drops of this medicine into each nostril.  One to two drops in each nostril, one or two times daily or as directed by the physician.Clean the dropper after application.

For Nasal Spray: Insert the spray nozzle inside the affected nostril. Press the pump to release the spray and sniff at the same time. Repeat the same to the other nostril if required. Clean the nozzle after application.

To avoid possible spread of infection, this pack should only be used by a single person. Do not use NASOLIFE PD NASAL DROPS for more than 7 days without consulting your doctor. Discard the unused portion after 28 days of opening it.

introduction:
Introduction About FLUOREN NASAL SPRAY

FLUOREN NASAL SPRAY contains Fluticasone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids (glucocorticoids). It is used to manage symptoms of allergic rhinitis such as stuffy, runny, or itchy nose, sneezing, itchy, red, or watery eyes in adults and children above 6 years of age.

Allergic rhinitis may be defined as an inflammatory disease of the nasal mucosa caused due to allergies caused form certain things such as pollen from grass or trees, animals (cats and dogs), house-dust mites, or moulds.

Before using FLUOREN NASAL SPRAY tell your doctor if you have severe liver disease, any history of eye conditions such as glaucoma (increase in pressure in the eye) or cataracts (clouding of the lens of the eye), or had nose surgery, or got an infection in your nose.

FLUOREN NASAL SPRAY should not be used in pregnant and breastfeeding women, unless advised clearly necessary by the doctor. Contact your doctor before using. FLUOREN NASAL SPRAY is not recommended for use in children below 6 years of age. FLUOREN NASAL SPRAY should be used with caution in elderly patients. Therefore, contact your doctor before using.

The most common side effects of using FLUOREN NASAL SPRAY include nosebleeds (generally minor), nasal ulceration, headache, and shortness of breath. Contact your doctor if any of these worsen or doesn’t improve.

FLUOREN NASAL SPRAY causes vasoconstriction (constriction of blood vessels) and has anti-inflammatory activity. It directly decreases the cells that cause inflammation such as eosinophils, monocytes, mast cells, macrophages, and dendritic cells. FLUOREN NASAL SPRAY also decreases mucus gland secretions. Therefore, helps in reducing inflammation and making it easier to breathe.

Your doctor will decide what quantity of dose you require at what frequency depending on the severity of the disease and your physical characteristics. Do not start or stop the medicine without consulting your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About MIST M NASAL SPRAY

MIST M NASAL SPRAY contains Mometasone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids. MIST M NASAL SPRAY is used to manage the symptoms of hay fever (seasonal allergic rhinitis) and perennial rhinitis in adults and children aged 2 and older. This medicine is also used to manage nasal polyps in adults aged 18 and over.

Hay Fever is an allergic reaction which occurs due to breathing in pollen from trees, grasses, weeds, molds and fungal spores generally characterized by blocked or runny nose, sneezing and coughing.

Perennial rhinitis is an inflammatory condition which occurs due to sensitivity to a variety of things such as house dust mite, animal hair, feathers and certain foods characterized by symptoms such as blocked nose, sneezing, itching that might occur for an hour or more on most days throughout the year.

Nasal polyps are small growths on the lining of the nose which usually affects both nostrils generally characterized by runny nose, and stuffiness.

Avoid using MIST M NASAL SPRAY, if you are allergic to Mometasone, and or have an unmanageed infection in your nose such as herpes, recent injury or operation on your nose.

Before using MIST M NASAL SPRAY, inform your doctor if you have kidney, or liver disease. MIST M NASAL SPRAY should be used in pregnant women only if it is clearly necessary. It should be used with caution in breastfeeding women.

Your doctor will give the right dose depends on your child’s age, body weight and disease condition. Consult your doctor before using MIST M NASAL SPRAY.

The most common side effects of using MIST M NASAL SPRAY are headache, sneezing, nose bleeds, sore nose or throat, ulcers in the nose and or respiratory tract infection. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms gets worsen.

Spray XYTROVAC OXY NASAL SPRAY/ DROPS 1-2 times in each nostril up to 3 times daily. Do not use for more than 7 days continuously. It continues to act up to 12 hours and thus provides quick and long-lasting relief from blocked nose.

XYTROVAC OXY NASAL SPRAY/ DROPS starts to unblock the nose within 25 seconds. It opens up the nasal passages and allows you to breathe normally. Because it is applied directly inside the nose.

The most common side effects of XYTROVAC OXY NASAL SPRAY/ DROPS are nasal dryness and discomfort, sneezing, headache, nausea or dizziness. Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects persists for a longer duration.

warnings.details: There are no well-controlled studies in pregnant women assessing the effects of oxymetazoline. A small study involving 12 healthy pregnant women reported that a single dose of oxymetazoline nasal spray did not affect uterine blood flow. Due to the lack of comprehensive studies, it is advisable to consult a healthcare provider before using oxymetazoline during pregnancy.

There is no available data on whether oxymetazoline passes into human breast milk. Since oxymetazoline is applied topically (nasal spray), systemic absorption is minimal, suggesting a low likelihood of significant transfer into breast milk. Due to the absence of specific data, it is recommended to consult a healthcare provider before using oxymetazoline while breastfeeding.
Do not drive or handle heavy tools or machines if you feel dizziness after using the medicine.
Do not use XYTROVAC OXY NASAL SPRAY/ DROPS if you are allergic to Oxymetazoline or any of the other ingredients of this medicine.
XYTROVAC OXY NASAL SPRAY/ DROPS should be used with caution if you have high blood pressure, heart disease or diabetes.
XYTROVAC OXY NASAL SPRAY/ DROPS is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 12 years of age.

XYTROVAC OXY NASAL SPRAY/ DROPS should be used with caution in elderly patients. Elderly individuals, especially those with hypertension, heart disease, glaucoma, or diabetes, should use XYTROVAC OXY NASAL SPRAY/ DROPS only after consulting a doctor. Since Oxymetazoline constricts blood vessels.
